article.articleHeadline: SRAG registra alta de 17% e soma 1.135 casos no Ceará
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SARI up 17% and totals 1,135 cases in Ceará.
article.articleSummary: In Ceará, Brazil, Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI) cases climbed 17% in recent weeks, totaling 1,135 as of 21 March 2026. The rise accompanies higher Influenza A positivity and is described as expected during the period of greatest viral circulation, per Ana Cabral, coordinator of Epidemiological Surveillance and Health Prevention for the state. SARI is a severe respiratory infection that can be triggered by viruses such as influenza and coronaviruses, among other respiratory agents. The report indicates ongoing transmission linked to the current viral-season period, with health monitoring continuing.

triage.headline_ja: SARI登録数が17%増加し、セアラ州で1,135件に到達
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でSARI/インフルエンザAの症例増加が報告されているが、当局は季節的変動と評価しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスク兆候は記事に記載されていない。経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: セアラ州保健局による公式なサーベイランス報告として、SARI症例の17%増加と1,135件の累積数が報告されている。当局の見解では季節的ウイルス流行期の予想される増加とされており、異常性は低い。死亡数や重症化率などの詳細な重症度情報は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 6 người trong cùng khu dân cư ở Đắk Lắk bị chó nghi dại cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six people in the same residential area in Đắk Lắk were bitten by dogs suspected of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Six people in Ea Na commune, Buôn Đôn District, Đắk Lắk Province, Vietnam, were bitten by dogs suspected of rabies, prompting a directive from Đắk Lắk Department of Health on 21 March 2026. The order requires delimiting the area, reviewing dog and cat populations, achieving high vaccination coverage, curbing roaming animals, and coordinating with veterinary services to investigate and monitor the outbreak. The provincial CDC will assess risk and ensure no exposure cases are missed, with timely management. Deputy Director Huỳnh Lê Xuân Bích warned that rabies is almost always fatal once symptoms develop, stressing robust vaccination of dogs and cats. Bite victims should immediately wash wounds with soap and clean water, then seek treatment or post-exposure prophylaxis; avoid folk remedies. Earlier in March, Buôn Đôn declared an animal rabies outbreak; in 2025 the province recorded seven rabies deaths, among the highest nationally.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク省同一住宅地区内の6名が狂犬病疑い犬に咬傷被害
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの狂犬病複数患者咬傷事例であり、IHR基準では「異常/予想外」「重症度（致死率ほぼ100%）」に該当し、WPROスクリーニングでも複数基準に該当。同地域での動物狂犬病アウトブレイク報告と連動しており、公衆衛生当局の対応が既に開始されている。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率が症状発症後ほぼ100%と極めて高い。同地域では2025年に7名の狂犬病死亡が記録され、全国で最も高い水準。3月には既に動物狂犬病アウトブレイク宣言済み。複数の公衆衛生対応（地域限定、動物ワクチン接種、行動管理等）が開始されており、政府の衛生当局が積極的に関与している。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação do vírus da gripe está em alta em várias regiões do país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza virus circulation is high in several regions of the country.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin (March 20, 2026) reports high circulation of Influenza A across Brazil, with SRAG activity rising in Mato Grosso and most Northeast states (except Piauí), plus the North (Amapá, Pará, Rondônia). In the Southeast, increases are noted in Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo. Since January 1, 2026, SRAG-related deaths were 37.3% SARS-CoV-2, 28.6% influenza A, 21.8% rhinovirus, 4.5% RSV, and 2.5% influenza B; in the four most recent weeks, deaths among positives were 30.8% influenza A, 30.8% SARS-CoV-2, 27.5% rhinovirus, 5.5% RSV, and 2.7% influenza B. The ministry outlines three national vaccination strategies for 2026 to expand coverage and reduce vaccine-preventable diseases. The influenza campaign runs March 28–May 30 across the Northeast, Central-West, South and Southeast, with Day D on March 28, 2026. RSV vaccine is available for pregnant women; influenza A vaccination begins March 28 for priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザウイルスの流行が国内複数地域で高い状況にある
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で季節性インフルエンザA型の流行が報告されており、複数州でSRAG活動が上昇中だが、既知の季節的流行パターン内と考えられる。情報不足のため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの年間流行パターンであり、ブラジル当局（Fiocruz、保健省）が既に認識・管理中。2026年3月の統計報告であり、公衆衛生対応（ワクチン接種キャンペーン等）が進行中。国際的拡大リスク評価に必要な詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Minsa anuncia alerta sanitaria tras muertes por leptospirosis: ¿quiénes son los más vulnerables al contagio? | El Popular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Ministry announces a health alert after leptospirosis-related deaths: who are the most vulnerable to infection?
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis has triggered a national health alert in Peru, with three deaths and over 1,000 cases reported by early 2026, according to the Ministry of Health (Minsa). The hardest-hit regions include Piura, San Martín, Tumbes and Junín, amid heavy rains and floods that facilitate transmission; overall, 25 regions are affected, including Amazonas, Áncash, Arequipa, Cajamarca, Cusco, Lambayeque, Lima, Loreto, Madre de Dios, Piura, San Martín, Tumbes and Ucayali. Transmission occurs through the urine of animals, especially rodents, with infection from contact with water or soil contaminated by urine. The report notes common symptoms but does not enumerate them. Minsa identifies high-risk populations and has launched information campaigns, distributed medical supplies, heightened surveillance in public and private facilities, and training for healthcare personnel to ensure timely diagnosis and limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がレプトスピラ症による死亡後に衛生警報を発表：感染に最も脆弱なのは誰か？
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症による複数死亡と1,000件以上の症例がペルー全域25地域で報告され、公式な衛生警報が発令されている。IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性が認められ、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: ペルー保健省（Minsa）が正式に衛生警報を発令。3名の死亡、1,000件以上の確定/疑い症例。25地域が影響を受けており、特にピウラ州、サンマルティン州、トゥンベス州、ヌニン州が重症地域。洪水による環境汚染がヒト-ヒト感染ではなく、齧歯動物尿を介した環境感染として伝播。ブラジルとの国境地域（ロレト州、アマゾナス州）も含まれ、国際的な拡大リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: India orders culling of 20,000 birds in Kerala amid bird flu outbreak
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) outbreak in Kerala, India prompts culling of more than 20,000 birds in Kozhikode (14,228) and Alappuzha (5,961) districts. Laboratory confirmation of highly pathogenic avian influenza was reported from samples sent to the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal. Culling operations begin Saturday within a one-km containment radius, carried out by rapid response teams from the Animal Husbandry Department. So far, the outbreak has been detected only in birds; no human cases reported. Authorities urge public vigilance and to report unusual mass bird deaths to the nearest veterinary hospital. The measures reflect an early, proactive containment and surveillance effort to prevent potential zoonotic transmission in southern India.

triage.headline_ja: インドがカエル州での鳥インフルエンザ流行を受け20,000羽の鳥の殺処分を命令
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザの確認例があり、複数地域での大規模殺処分が実施されている。人への感染は報告されていないが、人獣共通感染症である鳥インフルエンザの流行は国際的関心が高く、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザH5N1型と推定される。複数州（ケーラ州、マディヤプラデシュ州）での検出・対応があり、地理的な広がりを示唆している。現時点で人への感染は報告されていないが、人獣共通感染症としての監視強化とシグナル追跡が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz alerta para alta da gripe em várias regiões do Brasil - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz warns of a rise in influenza across several regions of Brazil
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin warns of rising Influenza A-driven Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI) across Brazil. Regions with increases include Mato Grosso; most Northeast states (excluding Piauí); North (Amapá, Pará, Rondônia); and Southeast (Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo). Since January 2026, SARI-positive etiologies are rhinovirus 41.9%, Influenza A 21.8%, SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) 14.7%, RSV 13.4%, Influenza B 1.5%. Among deaths, SARS-CoV-2 accounts for 37.3%, Influenza A 28.6%, rhinovirus 21.8%, RSV 4.5%, Influenza B 2.5%. In the last four epidemiological weeks, death distribution is: Influenza A 30.8%; SARS-CoV-2 30.8%; rhinovirus 27.5%; RSV 5.5%; Influenza B 2.7%. For 2026, three national vaccination strategies aim to boost coverage and reduce vaccine-preventable disease. The influenza vaccination campaign runs March 28–May 30 in the Northeast, Midwest, South and Southeast; Day D is March 28. RSV vaccine for pregnant women is available; influenza A vaccination begins March 28 for priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruzがブラジルの複数地域でのインフルエンザの上昇に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外の状況、国際的拡大リスク）。複数病原体による呼吸器感染症の同時流行兆候があり、ブラジル全域での複数州での症例増加が報告されている。
triage.notes: ブラジル全域7州以上での複数病原体（インフルエンザA/B、COVID-19、RSV）による呼吸器感染症の同時流行兆候。死亡率の上昇も報告されており、公式な予防接種キャンペーンが開始予定（3月28日）。過去4週間の死亡症例分布ではインフルエンザAとSARS-CoV-2がそれぞれ30.8%を占める。マルチプルシグナルとしての意義が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ceap-Sol alerta para importância do diagnóstico precoce no combate à tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceap-Sol warns of the importance of early diagnosis in the fight against tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: Ceap-Sol in Goiás, Brazil highlights early diagnosis and treatment adherence to curb tuberculosis, a persistent global and Brazilian public health challenge. In 2024, the world reported 10.7 million TB cases and 1.23 million deaths; Brazil recorded 85,936 new cases and 6,315 deaths. Goiás registered 5,498 confirmed TB cases from 2021–2025, with rising mortality, while Ceap-Sol treated 18 patients in 2025. Symptoms lasting more than two weeks—prolonged cough, persistent fever, loss of appetite, and unintentional weight loss—should trigger investigation. Transmission is airborne, especially before treatment starts. Diagnosis relies on laboratory tests and imaging, with sputum analysis for pulmonary disease. Treatment lasts at least six months and is highly effective when completed; interruptions risk drug resistance. Emphasis on vulnerable groups and childhood BCG vaccination. Services are free via SUS, and early detection reduces complications and halts transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Ceap-Sol 結核対策における早期診断の重要性について警告
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の流行疾患であり、ブラジル（特にゴイアス州）で継続的に発生している。記事は啓発・警告内容で新規アウトブレイクではなく、IHR基準は該当しない可能性が高いが、WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常性の判定に情報不足」のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の既知の流行に対する啓発活動である。ブラジルは2024年に85,936新規症例、6,315死亡を報告しており、結核は継続的な公衆衛生課題。ゴイアス州での2025年の患者数18名は地域の一施設の治療数であり、新規アウトブレイク信号ではない。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」が該当するが、これは既知の流行の継続であり新規シグナルではない。続報でより重大な増加傾向や新規クラスターが報告された場合はPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: 〈熱門股〉高端腸病毒疫苗進軍越南市場 笑納三根漲停 | 鉅亨網 - 台股新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hot stock: Premium enterovirus vaccine enters the Vietnam market, posts three consecutive limit-ups.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-21, Taiwan-developed premium enterovirus vaccine (Chinese: 高端恩穩健腸病毒疫苗) has entered Vietnam's market. After an August 2023 launch in Taiwan, cumulative sales exceed 500,000 doses and capture about 95% of Taiwan's self-paid enterovirus vaccine market. The company aims to replicate this success in Southeast Asia. In 2023, it submitted for new-drug registration to Vietnam Drug Administration (DAV) and signed a regional distribution contract with S-Bio; in 2025, it signed a memorandum of understanding with VNVC vaccination system. Vietnam's drug licensing of this enterovirus vaccine marks the first such license issued by Vietnamese authorities and represents the first Taiwan-originated innovative vaccine moving into overseas markets. The development coincides with a stock market surge, noted as three consecutive limit-ups."

triage.headline_ja: 高端腸病毒ワクチンがベトナム市場に進出、3日連続のストップ高を記録
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン製品の市場進出と株価動向に関する経済ニュースであり、感染症の流行・アウトブレイク・健康危機を報告するイベント情報ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれも該当せず。
triage.notes: 本件はワクチン製品開発・商品化・市場展開に関する企業ニュース・株価情報であり、感染症イベント監視対象外。腸病毒感染症の流行報告、患者数増加、重症例、死亡報告、または異常なアウトブレイクの情報は含まれていない。Bluedot APIの誤分類と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Sorriso recebe primeiras doses da vacina Butantan-DV contra a dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sorriso receives the first doses of the Butantan-DV dengue vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Sorriso, Brazil, begins using Butantan-DV, a 100% domestic, single-dose dengue vaccine, for health professionals in the municipality’s primary care network starting March 24. The city received 275 doses on March 20, covering about 50% of primary care staff; rollout will be phased. The vaccine targets ages 15–59, with initial uptake prioritizing staff at basic health units and expanding to other groups. Butantan-DV is the world’s first single-dose dengue vaccine, protecting against all four dengue serotypes. Clinical data show 74% overall efficacy, a 91% reduction in severe dengue, and 100% protection against dengue-related hospitalization. Background: in 2024 Brazil became the first country to offer dengue vaccination in SUS; children and adolescents 10–14 continue with a two-dose vaccine, with adolescent vaccination available in all municipal vaccination rooms. In 2025, dengue cases in Brazil fell 74% to about 1.7 million probable cases, with 1,700 deaths (down 72%).

triage.headline_ja: ソリソ市がブタンタン-DV デング熱ワクチンの最初の用量を受け取る
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントはデング熱ワクチン導入に関する肯定的なニュースであり、感染症危機を示すシグナルではない。ブラジルではデング熱症例が実際に減少傾向（2024年比74%減）にあり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態の要件を満たしていない。
triage.notes: この記事はワクチン接種プログラムの進捗を報告しており、新規アウトブレイクやシグナル検出ではない。ブラジルでのデング熱は管理下にあり、症例数は大幅に減少している。EBS活動としてのシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി: കോഴിക്കോട് അഞ്ചിടങ്ങളിൽ നിന്നായി 15,000 പക്ഷികളെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu: 15,000 birds to be culled from five sites in Kozhikode
article.articleSummary: Bird flu (avian influenza) confirmed in Kozhikode district, Kerala as of 2026-03-21. To curb the outbreak, authorities will cull about 15,000 birds today within a one-kilometer radius of infected zones spanning five panchayats: Panangad, Olavanna, Kakodi, Perumanna, and Nallalam. The culling targets both wild birds and poultry in the affected areas to stem viral spread. The measure follows confirmation of the disease in the region and is part of intensified preventive actions. No other details on laboratory confirmation or infection source are provided. The operation focuses on rapid reduction of potential reservoir hosts within the defined perimeter to protect surrounding farms and communities.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：コーチン地区の5つの地点で15,000羽の鳥を殺処分予定
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1相当の可能性）がインド・ケーララ州で確認され、大規模な殺処分措置が実施される。複数地点での発生、人への感染リスク、地域コミュニティへの影響があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 発生地はインド・ケーララ州コーチン地区および複数の他地域（タミルナドゥ州、ナイジェリア・ボルノ州も報告されている）。記事からは人感染例の直接的言及はないが、鳥インフルエンザの人獣共通感染リスク、複数地点での同時発生、大規模殺処分実施は管理の困難さを示唆。配信日時が2026-03-21と将来日付であるため、実現性の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சல் எதிரொலி: கிண்டி சிறுவர் இயற்கை பூங்கா மூடல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian Influenza Aftermath: Kindi Children's Nature Park Closed.
article.articleSummary: Chennai, India — Avian influenza has been confirmed among birds at Kindi Children's Nature Park, prompting a temporary closure of the facility. The park, a popular children's destination in Chennai, normally attracts about 2,000 visitors on typical weekdays and around 5,000 on weekends. The report focuses on the avian influenza in park birds and does not provide information on human infections or other related outbreaks at the site. No further details were provided. The closure indicates park operations have been halted pending resolution of the avian influenza situation. Date: 2026-03-21.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの余波：ギンディ子ども自然公園の閉園
triage.triage_reason: インド・チェンナイの野鳥からの鳥インフルエンザ確認だが、人間への感染報告がなく、国際的拡大の証拠も不明。動物由来感染症として注視が必要だが、現時点では判定保留。
triage.notes: 記事は野鳥での鳥インフルエンザ確認に限定。人間感染の報告なし。公園閉園は実施されているが、感染規模、ウイルス種（H5N1等）、人間への感染リスク評価が不明。動物-人間感染への進展可能性のため継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância Sanitária revela o que encontrou em pizzaria da PB após morte de cliente e hospitalização de mais de 100 pessoas - Hugo Gloss
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sanitary Surveillance reveals what it found at a pizza restaurant in Paraíba after a customer's death and hospitalization of more than 100 people - Hugo Gloss
article.articleSummary: Sanitary inspectors in Paraíba, Brazil, found major sanitary irregularities at La Favoritta, a pizza restaurant in Pombal, including pest infestations (cockroaches, flies, and mosquitoes) and only one bathroom. A 44-year-old woman died after dining there; she presented on Monday (16) with diarrhea, intense vomiting, and abdominal pain and died Tuesday at 8:59. In total, 118 people sought medical care with suspected foodborne illness linked to the same establishment on Sunday. The health agencies say the pizza possibly associated with the episode was sent for microbiological culture; if microorganisms grow, further tests will identify the causative agent. Clinical samples from patients are being analyzed to confirm the etiologic agent and its link to food consumption; results are expected in 10–15 days. The restaurant owner is cooperating with authorities, and investigations are conducted by Agevisa and the Paraíba Health Secretariat.

triage.headline_ja: サニタリー監視が、顧客の死亡と100人以上の入院後、パライーバ州のピザレストランで発見したもの を明かす
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒疑い患者118名が医療ケアを求め、1名の死亡報告があり、IHR基準における重大な公衆衛生への影響および異常性が認められる。国家レベルの衛生監視機関が関与し、調査が進行中である。
triage.notes: 原因物質は未特定（Unknown Illness）であるが、食中毒の可能性が高い。微生物培養および臨床サンプル分析結果は10～15日後に報告予定。ブラジル国内のAgevisa（サニタリー監視機関）および州保健局による活発な調査が進行中。ベクター（蚊）が影響カテゴリに含まれているため、デング熱等の媒介感染症の可能性も排除できないが、現時点では食中毒が主要シナリオ。

article.articleHeadline: 今年錄4宗腦膜炎全屬本地感染　關日華倡提升前線醫生斷症能力
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year four meningitis cases have been recorded, all locally acquired; Kwan Jat-wah advocates improving frontline doctors' diagnostic abilities.
article.articleSummary: Four meningitis cases have been recorded in Hong Kong this year, all locally acquired with no travel history during incubation, and authorities warn that sporadic local cases may continue. One 3-year-old boy in Hong Kong is severely ill with invasive meningococcal disease. Public health expert Kwan Jat-wah urges stronger frontline diagnostic abilities, noting the rapid transmission of meningococcal infections and that Hong Kong’s incidence remains very low. In the United Kingdom, Kent reports an invasive meningococcal disease outbreak now totaling 29 cases with two student deaths; the circulating strain is serogroup B, associated with higher severity. Early symptoms include high fever, severe headache, and rash; transmission can occur via close contact. Vaccination is advised for high-risk travelers and takes two weeks to become effective, so Easter travel plans should vaccinate promptly, alongside reinforced hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 今年錄4宗腦膜炎全屬本地感染　關日華倡提升前線醫生斷症能力
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の複数地域での同時発生、英国ケント州での流行（29例、死亡2例）、香港での本地感染4例（渡航歴なし）が報告されており、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。国際的な関心と複数国での同時発生のため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 英国ケント州での流行規模（29例、死亡2例）が特に懸念。香港での本地感染4例が渡航歴なしという点が重要。髄膜炎菌血清群B（重症度高い）の循環が確認されている。複数国での同時発生パターンは国際的なサーベイランスコーディネーションが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Felipeh Campos é internado com dengue e atualiza estado de saúde nas redes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Felipeh Campos is hospitalized with dengue fever and updates his health status on social media.
article.articleSummary: Felipeh Campos, a 52-year-old Brazilian journalist and TV presenter, was hospitalized at Beneficência Portuguesa de São Paulo with a severe dengue fever. Admission was for intensive monitoring and appropriate treatment due to symptom severity; there was no estimated discharge date, and his health status remained under continuous medical supervision. In a social media update, Campos said he is better, stronger, and fully aware of what happened. Dengue complications necessitate rigorous hydration and constant observation, underscoring the potential severity of the illness. The report situates the case in São Paulo, Brazil, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation or infection source.

triage.headline_ja: フェリペ・カンポス氏、デング熱で入院し、SNSで健康状態を更新
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の個別症例報告であり、ブラジルのサンパウロで確認されている。ただし、公衆衛生への広域的影響、異常な流行パターン、国際的な拡大リスクの証拠は記事から明確でなく、個別事例の報道レベルにとどまるため、続報を注視する段階である。
triage.notes: 記事は有名なジャーナリスト・テレビ司会者の個別入院事例であり、一般向けニュース・社会的関心は存在するが、感染症としてのアウトブレイク警告信号ではない。ブラジルではデング熱は季節的に既知の公衆衛生課題であり、この個別重症事例は異常ではない。感染源、ラボ確認、接触者追跡の情報が不足している。地域的な流行パターンの詳細が明らかになれば、再評価が必要な場合もある。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue và những dự định dở dang bên giường bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and unfinished plans at the bedside.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever remains a public health concern in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, with adults increasingly affected. At the Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Ho Chi Minh City, a 34-year-old man illustrates dengue’s dangerous defervescence phase: fever subsides, yet shock risk rises as plasma leakage, hemoconcentration and thrombocytopenia progress to dengue shock syndrome, liver or kidney failure, or multiorgan injury. Severe cases have risen from about 15% to 17–19% in recent years. The disease appears year-round, with peaks June–October, driven by urbanization and climate change; Aedes mosquitoes breed in clean-water containers inside homes. Many patients delay care with at-home treatment, worsening outcomes. Families endure economic and social disruption, as illustrated by parents at BV Nhi Dong 1. Prevention highlights eliminating breeding sites, covering water storage, using nets and vector-control, and vaccination. Warning signs requiring urgent care include high fever, severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と病床での未完成の計画
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ホーチミン市でのデング熱とSFTS患者の同時発生。重症例の増加傾向（15%→17-19%）、成人患者の増加、デング出血熱ショック症候群への進展リスク、通年の流行パターンが報告されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 複数疾患（デング熱とSFTS）の同時報告。重症化率の上昇傾向、成人患者の増加、通年流行パターンの継続、家庭内の受診遅延による転帰悪化が指摘されている。都市化と気候変動が流行促進要因として言及。ベトナム公式メディア（baochinhphu.vn）からの報告であり、信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Những thắc mắc thường gặp về não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Frequently Asked Questions About Meningococcal Meningitis
article.articleSummary: An 11-year-old girl in Phu Quoc, Vietnam, died of meningococcal meningitis, prompting rapid contact tracing, isolation of close contacts, and environmental cleaning to prevent spread. The disease begins with abrupt fever, headache, sore throat, and fatigue; severe cases may include neck stiffness, rash, or seizures, with infants showing irritability or poor feeding. Nasopharyngeal carriage is common (10–20%), and transmission occurs via respiratory droplets or contaminated surfaces, especially in schools or dormitories. Close contacts—household members, roommates, classmates, or caregivers—should receive prophylaxis and be monitored for 10 days; the exposure window spans seven days before to 24 hours after antibiotic initiation. Vietnam licenses five vaccines: MenQuadfi and Nimenrix for serogroups A, C, Y, W; Menactra for 9 months–55 years; Bexsero and VA-Mengoc-BC for group B. Vaccination should be early and in combination (B plus A/C/Y/W) since no cross-protection. Maintain hygiene, ventilation, and masking in public spaces.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎についてよくある質問
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのフーコック島で11歳女児の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による死亡事例が報告され、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響および異常性が認識される。急速な接触者追跡と対応措置が実施されている。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は致死率が高く、ベトナムにおける死亡事例の報告は重大なシグナルである。学校や寮などの集団環境での感染リスク、飛沫感染の可能性、接触者への予防投与と10日間の監視体制が記述されており、管理可能性の課題が示唆される。ワクチン戦略（複数血清型）についても言及されているが、国内での流行規模や他地域への波及については記事サマリーに明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട് പക്ഷിപ്പനി; അഞ്ച് പഞ്ചായത്തിൽ 15,000 പക്ഷികളെ കൊന്നൊടുക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kozhikode Bird Flu; 15,000 birds will be culled in five panchayats.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) confirmed in Kozhikode district, Kerala. Authorities will culled about 15,000 birds today across Panangad, Olavanna, Kakkodi, Perumanna, and Nallalam panchayats to curb spread. Birds and poultry within a one-kilometer radius of infected areas will be culled. There is no current human infection and officials say the situation is not yet alarming, but surveillance and precautionary measures are being intensified. Laboratory testing identified the virus as Avian Influenza A/H5N1. Health and animal husbandry departments warn the public not to touch dead birds or visibly sick poultry to prevent potential transmission. Ongoing outbreak response emphasizes containment through culling, surveillance, and strict biosafety, with no reported human cases as of 2026-03-21.

triage.headline_ja: コジコード鳥インフルエンザ；5つのパンチャヤトで15,000羽の鳥が殺処分される
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の確定症例（動物）が複数地域で報告され、大規模な殺処分対応が開始されている。IHR基準では異常/予想外性と国際拡大リスクが該当し、スクリーニング基準でも複数項目（異常性、長期曝露可能性、流行しやすさ、管理対応）が該当するためPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: H5N1は高病原性鳥インフルエンザであり、ヒト感染の潜在的リスクがある。現在までヒト症例は報告されていないが、複数地域での感染確認と大規模殺処分実施により、地域的なバイオセキュリティ上の懸念が存在。配信日時が2026年となっているため、日付確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: อาการแบบไหน? เสี่ยงติดเชื้อทางเดินปัสสาวะโดยไม่รู้ตัว
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What symptoms? At risk of a urinary tract infection without realizing it.
article.articleSummary: Urinary tract infection (UTI) symptoms and prevention in Thailand: UTIs are commonly caused by Escherichia coli and can ascend from the bladder to the kidneys. Classic signs include frequent or painful urination, lower abdominal (suprapubic) fullness, and sometimes fever or chills if the infection spreads. Urine may be cloudy, strong-smelling, or pink/red if there is blood. Women are more susceptible due to a shorter urethra. Prevention emphasizes hydration, not delaying urination, postcoital urination, and proper genital hygiene; after bowel movements wipe front-to-back; avoid irritants and change menstrual pads regularly. Treatment is usually antibiotics, with improvement in 2–3 days; complete the full course to prevent resistance. Recurrent UTIs may warrant low-dose preventive therapy; probiotics may help reduce long-term risk. If symptoms persist or worsen, further evaluation is advised to prevent kidney involvement. Published 2026-03-21.

triage.headline_ja: どのような症状ですか？知らないうちに尿路感染症のリスクにさらされています
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は一般的なE. coli由来の尿路感染症（UTI）の症状と予防方法についての教育的情報であり、異常な発生事例、流行、または公衆衛生上の危機を報告していない。
triage.notes: 本記事はバンコク医療ニュースサイトによる一般向けの健康啓発記事であり、特定の集団発生事例やアウトブレイク報告ではない。タイにおけるUTIの予防・対策についての一般情報提供であるため、感染症危機管理のシグナルトリアージ対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe avança rápido antes do período sazonal - 21/03/2026 - Equilíbrio e Saúde - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu Spreads Quickly Ahead of Flu Season - March 21, 2026 - Balance and Health - Folha
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports rapid spread of influenza A and rhinovirus ahead of the autumn-winter peak, per Infogripe/Fiocruz monitoring for the SUS. Autumn began March 20, using epidemiological week 10 (Mar 8–14). Influenza A drives increases in severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) in Mato Grosso and most Northeast states (except Piauí), plus Amapá, Pará, and Rondônia, and in Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo in the Southeast. By March 20, 2026, 20,300 SRAG cases were notified, with 7,523 lab-confirmed for a respiratory virus. Among positives: rhinovirus 41.9%, influenza A 21.8%, and COVID-19 14.7%. The Ministry of Health reports 865 SRAG deaths through March 14, with 345 virus-confirmed; COVID-19 accounted for 37% of these deaths, followed by influenza A at 28%.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザが季節性流行期の前に急速に拡大 - 2026年3月21日 - バランスと健康 - フォーリャ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全国で複数の呼吸器疾患（インフルエンザAおよびCOVID-19）の急速な拡大が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当する。さらに複数州での大規模な拡がりと死亡者増加により、スクリーニング基準「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「長期曝露」を満たし、フルRRAの実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事日付が2026年3月となっており未来日付である点に注意。実データであれば時間軸確認が必要。Infogripe/Fiocruzによる公式監視データに基づき、ブラジル保健省が関与している。複数州（北東部、北部、南東部）での同時流行で地理的拡がりが大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Nova variante da mpox acende alerta na OMS por possível resistência a tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New mpox variant raises alarm at the WHO over possible resistance to treatment.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (mpox) faces a new recombinant variant arising from recombination between clades Ib and IIb, drawing global attention from the World Health Organization. The first case was identified in India (symptoms in 2025), with a second case confirmed in the United Kingdom; there is no evidence of chain transmission. The recombinant variant may complicate detection and disease control, raising concerns about diagnostic and therapeutic gaps. A New England Journal of Medicine study found that tecovirimat—the main antiviral—did not significantly shorten recovery time in immunocompetent patients, prompting reevaluation of standard therapy. The WHO urges intensified global surveillance and continued research, noting the virus is evolving even without evidence of higher lethality. No panic, but cautious, proactive monitoring and updated treatment strategies are required as of 21 March 2026.

triage.headline_ja: OMS警戒：新しいMpox変異株が治療薬耐性の可能性で注目を集める
triage.triage_reason: Mpoxの新規組み換え変異株（Ib×IIbの組み換え体）の出現に加え、主要抗ウイルス薬テコビリマットの有効性が限定的であることが報告されており、IHR基準複数該当および治療管理可能性の懸念が高い。複数国（インド、英国、米国を含む）での報告と国際的なWHOの警報により、シグナルトリアージ対象。
triage.notes: Mpoxの新規組み換え変異株（クレード Ib と IIb の組み換え体）が報告される。インドで初期症例（2025年の症状）、英国で第2症例が確認されており、連鎖感染の証拠はない。ただし、診断検査および治療戦略の有効性に関する懸念が主焦点。NEJM研究により、主要抗ウイルス薬テコビリマットが免疫機能正常者の回復時間を有意に短縮しなかったことが報告され、標準治療の再評価を促している。WHO が強化された世界的サーベイランスを要請。記事日付は2026年3月21日（将来日付のため注意）。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ sơ sinh mắc thủy đậu suy hô hấp nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newborns with chickenpox and severe respiratory failure.
article.articleSummary: On 21 March 2026, a 12-day-old newborn with varicella (chickenpox) complicated by pneumonia and severe respiratory failure was saved at Lao Cai Provincial Obstetrics and Pediatrics Hospital. The infant was admitted after 3 days of fever and a generalized vesicular rash with poor feeding; the condition rapidly progressed to respiratory failure and pneumonia. He required mechanical ventilation, antiviral therapy, antibiotics, intensive care, and nasogastric feeding. After 10 days of treatment, the baby began breathing spontaneously, fed well, skin lesions resolved, and overall health stabilized. Varicella-Zoster virus spreads via respiratory droplets and direct contact; in newborns, infection can lead to pneumonia, respiratory failure, hepatitis, and potentially death if not promptly treated. Experts advise pregnant women to limit contact with suspected cases, vaccination during pregnancy where appropriate, and families with newborns to monitor fever, rash, and feeding difficulties and seek early care. Preventive measures include hygiene, handwashing, isolation, and protecting high-risk individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘と重度呼吸不全を発症した新生児
triage.triage_reason: 新生児の水痘による重度合併症（肺炎・呼吸不全）の個別事例報告であり、異常性と重症度は認められるが、集団発生や国際的拡大のリスク、流行状況の明確な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: IHR基準は2つ該当するが、報道内容は医学的教育・啓発記事の性質が強く、集団発生やアウトブレイク通知ではない。WPRO基準も2つ該当するが、「流行しやすさ」や「管理可能性」については記事に情報がなく判定困難。地域レベルの予防措置が既に実施されている旨が記載されているため、「WATCH」とし続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação do vírus da gripe está em alta em várias regiões do país - OPINIÃO E NOTÍCIA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza virus circulation is high in several regions of the country - Opinion and News
article.articleSummary: Influenza A circulation is high across Brazil, per Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin released March 20, 2026. SRAG activity is rising in Mato Grosso and most Northeast states (except Piauí), and in the North (Amapá, Pará, Rondônia); in the Southeast, Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo show higher activity. Since the start of 2026, SRAG deaths have been linked to SARS-CoV-2 (37.3%), influenza A (28.6%), rhinovirus (21.8%), RSV (4.5%), and influenza B (2.5%). In the last four epidemiological weeks, deaths were 30.8% influenza A, 30.8% SARS-CoV-2, 27.5% rhinovirus, 5.5% RSV, 2.7% influenza B. The ministry outlines three national vaccination strategies for 2026 aiming to boost coverage. The influenza campaign runs March 28–May 30 in the Northeast, Central-West, South, and Southeast, with D-Day set for March 28; influenza A vaccination for priority groups begins March 28, and RSV vaccine is available for pregnant women.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザウイルスの流行は国内の複数地域で高まっている
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で複数の呼吸器系ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV、インフルエンザB）が同時流行し、SRAG関連死が継続的に報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「国の予想を超えた広がり」に該当する。国家的な予防接種戦略が展開中であることから、既に公衆衛生当局が重大視している。
triage.notes: ブラジルのFiocruz InfoGripeが公式通報（2026年3月20日）しており、複数州でSRAG活動が上昇中。2026年初以降、SRAG死亡者の約30%がインフルエンザAで、同じく30%がSARS-CoV-2、27.5%がライノウイルス、5.5%がRSVと報告されている。保健省が3月28日から全国的な予防接種キャンペーンを展開予定であることから、国家的な対応が進行中である。国際的な拡大リスクについての記載はないため「不明」評価。

article.articleHeadline: Zimbabwe on high alert as foot-and-mouth disease threat grows
article.articleSummary: Zimbabwe remains on high alert for Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) amid a regional SADC threat, with a virulent Type O identified in Mozambique and Zambia. In Zimbabwe, infections are confined to ecological hotspots along wildlife corridors and near national parks, Four and Five. The Zambezi River provides a barrier to Zambia, but movement across the Mozambican border remains a higher risk. About 316,000 cattle across four districts are under FMD quarantine, excluding them from live animals and products trade. Suspected cases continue and are reported to the World Organisation for Animal Health after laboratory confirmations. Most confirmed outbreaks are in Mangwe District near Botswana; concerns about spread to districts like Bikita, Gokwe, and Gutu persist. Vaccine shortages hamper vaccination; new doses are expected from Botswana to resume campaigns around conservancies and parks. Containment measures include movement restrictions, roadblocks, fencing around Gonarezhou (extending to Hwange) and intensified biosecurity training.

triage.headline_ja: ジンバブエが口蹄疫の脅威の増大に高度の警戒態勢で対応
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は動物疾病であるが、地域的な多国間の流行（ザンビア、モザンビーク、ジンバブエ、ボツワナ）を示し、ウイルス型O（高病原性）が確認されており、31万6千頭以上の家畜が隔離下にあり、国際貿易制限のリスクが高い。IHR基準では動物疾病だが、WPRO基準の異常性・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性（ワクチン不足）に複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物疾病（FMD）であるため、人間の感染症ではないが、地域規模での多国間流行、高病原性ウイルス株の確認、大規模な家畜隔離と貿易制限、ワクチン供給不足による管理困難性により、OIE（世界動物保健機関）レベルのシグナルとして識別される。SADC地域での地政学的影響と経済的影響（貿易制限）も高い。

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சல்: கிண்டி சிறுவர் பூங்கா மூடல்.! சுகாதாரத்துறை முக்கிய அறிவுறுத்தல்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza: Kindi Children's Park Closed. Health Department Issues Important Advisory.
article.articleSummary: At Kindi Children’s Park in Chennai, more than 20 birds died suddenly, with additional avian deaths in surrounding areas. Lab testing confirmed the fatalities were due to avian influenza (bird flu). The park has been closed pending safety assessments. As of 21 March 2026, there have been no human infections reported. Health officials advise residents to avoid panic, practice hygiene, and handle animals/birds cautiously. People with cough or cold symptoms should not self-medicate and should consult a government doctor. Emphasized precautions include regular handwashing and keeping environments clean, and avoiding consumption of raw or undercooked eggs and meat. Do not spread or believe unverified rumours about bird flu. For more information, contact 104.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：チェンナイのギンディー子ども公園が閉鎖。保健当局が重要な注意喚起を発表
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザの確認例が複数地域で報告され、公共施設の閉鎖措置が取られている。人獣共通感染症であり、国際的な拡大リスクがあるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: インドのタミル・ナードゥ州チェンナイで鳥インフルエンザが確認されており、20羽以上の鳥が死亡。現在のところ人間への感染報告はないが、人獣共通感染症であり、周囲への拡大リスクが存在。保健当局による積極的な情報提供と予防措置（公園閉鎖、衛生啓発）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk: Sáu trường hợp bị chó nghi mắc bệnh dại tấn công đã được tiêm vaccine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak: Six people attacked by dogs suspected of having rabies have been vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: On March 21, 2026, Dak Lak's Department of Health reported six people in Thành Công hamlet, Ea Na commune, bitten by a dog suspected of rabies. An initial rabid-appearing dog died in February; a second dog attacked on March 15, biting six people (three family members and three residents) and three neighboring dogs. All six bite victims have received rabies vaccination. The three bitten dogs have been captured and quarantined for monitoring. Authorities are implementing rapid control measures: census and management of dogs and cats; require owners to confine animals and ensure high vaccination coverage; health workers to monitor exposure cases and promote timely post-exposure vaccination. The provincial CDC will conduct epidemiological investigation and guide outbreak response, including disinfection and source control. Officials warn higher rabies risk with hot weather. Earlier in March, Buon Don district declared animal rabies outbreak with a 3-km containment zone.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク州：狂犬病が疑われる犬に襲われた6人がワクチン接種を受けた
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の疑いありで対策実施中だが、既に6人全員がワクチン接種完了、死亡例なし、地域的封じ込め措置実施中。現時点では致命的なアウトブレイク兆候が限定的だが、引き続き監視が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は報道価値が高い疾患で、地方当局が積極的に対応中。ただし6人全員が迅速にワクチン接種を受けており、犬の隔離監視も実施。国際拡大リスク低く、死亡例なし。同州では3月にBuon Don地区で別のアニマルアウトブレイク宣言あり、監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 林文健稱不排除腦膜炎雙球菌感染上升　會留意入境人士有否病徵 - RTHK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lam Man-kin says that an uptick in meningococcal infections cannot be ruled out; will monitor inbound travelers for symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Public health officials in Hong Kong are monitoring invasive meningococcal disease linked to a Kent, England outbreak. The UK cluster has at least 29 cases with 2 deaths; Hong Kong recorded 11 cases last year and four so far this year, the most recent a 3-year-old boy. Symptoms include sudden fever, severe headache, and possibly a rash. Authorities say sources are hard to pinpoint; the Kent outbreak appears driven by a young-person gathering with close contact, crowded conditions, and sharing drinks. In Hong Kong, invasive meningococcal disease is notifiable; officials will monitor inbound travelers for symptoms during Easter and have informed local students via the Hong Kong/London office. Prophylaxis for close contacts with antibiotics and vaccination for the general public are available, with emphasis on personal hygiene and vaccination as effective prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 林文健稱不排除腦膜炎雙球菌感染上升　會留意入境人士有否病徵
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌感染症は公衆衛生上の重大な影響を有し、国際的な拡大リスク（英国ケント州での29例2死と香港での増加傾向）が認識されている。2つ以上のIHR基準該当とWPRO基準複数該当のため。
triage.notes: 英国ケント州での集団発生（29例、死亡2例）が香港当局の監視対象となっており、国際的な公衆衛生の懸念が明確。香港での症例増加（昨年11例、本年4例）と入国者モニタリング実施がイースター期間に予定されている。ヒト-ヒト感染の高い可能性と管理戦略（予防抗生物質、ワクチン接種）が整備されている。

article.articleHeadline: ยโสธร ประกาศเขตโรคระบาดพิษสุนัขบ้า อำเภอป่าติ้ว
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yasothon declares rabies outbreak zone in Pa Tiw District.
article.articleSummary: Yasothon Province, Thailand, declared a 5-km rabies outbreak zone in Pa Tio District after laboratory confirmation of rabies in a dog from Pho Sai Subdistrict. The bite occurred March 18; a dog head sample tested positive at the Lower Northeastern Veterinary Research Center in Surin. Public health actions included vaccinating a bitten child with a booster and rabies immunoglobulin at Yasothon Hospital, with the patient stable at home. Six high-risk contacts were identified; all completed vaccination. The province’s Livestock Office declared the area a temporary outbreak zone covering 18 villages within Pho Sai and parts of Si Than Subdistrict, with about 3,100 dogs and cats in the zone. Over 300 dogs have been vaccinated (~85%), with full vaccination of households in 1–2 days. Authorities emphasize the 5Y guidelines and prompt medical care for bites to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ヤソートン県がパーティウ地区の狂犬病アウトブレイク区域を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の犬での確定ケースと人への曝露が確認され、当局が制御措置を実施中。現在のところ人への死亡例はなく、濃厚接触者への予防接種も完了しているため、IHR基準2つ以上の明確な該当は認められないが、情報が限定的であり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は高致死率疾患であり、人への進展リスクは常に存在する。当局の迅速な対応（患者の即時予防接種、濃厚接触者の特定・接種、犬の広範な予防接種）により現在のところ制御されているが、さらなる動物咬傷や未検査ケースの出現に注視が必要。記事には死亡例・重症例の言及がないが、同地域での今後の人獣共通感染症の監視継続を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Over 100,000 cases of TB recorded in NCR, says Health dept
article.articleSummary: National Capital Region (NCR), Philippines, reports 101,807 tuberculosis (TB) cases, per DOH-MMCHD. The agency emphasizes intensified early detection through screening as World TB Day on March 24 approaches. Regional Director Lester Tan notes TB remains one of the country’s top illnesses but is curable with early diagnosis and treatment, warning that hiding or delaying care worsens outcomes. To boost awareness and testing, DOH-MMCHD organized a TB-Free Generation Fun Run in Taguig City. The statement underscores ongoing TB surveillance and public health campaigns in Metro Manila, prioritizing screening, community engagement, and timely treatment to curb transmission in the NCR and ensure a healthier population ahead of World TB Day.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン国家首都圏（NCR）で結核の患者数が10万例を超えると保健省が報告
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、報告された101,807例はNCRの既存の疾病負担の一部と考えられるが、患者数の多さと公衆衛生への影響の程度を確認するために情報が不足しており、経過観察が必要である。
triage.notes: 結核はフィリピンの既知の風土病であり、100万人以上の患者数という背景では予想外ではない。ただし10万例の新規報告は重症度と長期曝露リスクを示唆している。World TB Day（3月24日）に向けた公衆衛生キャンペーンが実施されており、政府と公的関心が存在する。国際的な拡大やIHR基準の2つ以上該当がないため、現段階ではWATCHとして位置付けが適切。追加情報（発生動向、新規/既報例の区別、患者の転帰など）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bantul Siaga Risiko KLB dan Kasus Keracunan Saat Lebaran - Harianjogja.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bantul Health Office on Alert for Risk of Outbreak and Poisoning Cases During Eid al-Fitr - Harianjogja.com
article.articleSummary: Bantul Health Office in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, issues an alert as of March 21, 2026 for Eid al-Fitr to anticipate potential extraordinary health events (KLB), disease outbreaks, and food-poisoning as community gatherings rise. All health facilities, including puskesmas and hospitals, are ordered to stay on high alert and report suspected cases via the Early Warning and Response System (SKDR). Malaria surveillance is intensified, with rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) used for early detection, especially for individuals with travel history from endemic areas. The department also prepares for outbreaks of measles and rubella, pertussis, diphtheria, and upper respiratory infections (ISPA), all vaccine-preventable, requiring enhanced monitoring. Jamkesda local health coverage will be activated to ensure timely treatment without administrative barriers. No case counts are provided; emphasis is on rapid detection and response to potential outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: バントゥル保健局、イード・アル=フィトル時期の流行リスク・食中毒事例に警戒態勢を敷く
triage.triage_reason: 複数の予防接種対象疾患（麻疹、風疹、百日咳、ジフテリア）とマラリアについて、イード・アル=フィトル時の集会増加に伴う潜在的流行リスクの警戒が発令されている。ただし、現在のところ確認された症例数が報告されておらず、情報が限定的であるため、経過観察が適切である。
triage.notes: インドネシア・ヨグヤカルタ州バントゥル地域からの警告情報。複数の疾患（麻疹、風疹、百日咳、ジフテリア、マラリア）に対する予防的警戒であり、現在のところ確認症例数の報告がない。イード・アル=フィトルという宗教的集会時期と関連し、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクが存在する予防接種対象疾患が対象となっている。情報が限定的であるため、フルRRAまでは進まず経過観察段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Hygiene urged on public to ward off meningitis risk - RTHK
article.articleSummary: Three-year-old boy in Hong Kong diagnosed with invasive meningococcal infection; fever and vomiting on March 17, admitted March 18, with blood and cerebrospinal fluid tests positive for meningococcus and a clinical diagnosis of meningitis; patient in serious condition. The Centre for Health Protection reports four meningococcal cases in Hong Kong this year so far. Dr. Mike Kwan, president of the Asian Society for Paediatric Infectious Diseases, urges good personal hygiene, noting sporadic cases will continue and outbreak risk varies with environment and gatherings. Symptoms can include fever and skin rashes; asymptomatic carriers may comprise about 10% of Hong Kong’s population. The article cites a hospital renovation-site cluster last year as an example of workplace spread. Authorities are monitoring a recent invasive meningococcal outbreak in Kent, England, but the Hong Kong case is not believed linked to the UK cluster.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生管理の徹底を呼びかけ　髄膜炎リスク軽減へ - RTHK

triage.notes: 香港での3歳男児の重症髄膜炎菌感染症確定報告、本年度4例目。英国ケント州での集団発生との関連は否定されているが、国際的な疾病監視の対象となっている。不顕性キャリアが人口の約10%存在する可能性が指摘されており、地域内での拡大リスクが懸念される。RTHK公式ソースであり情報信頼性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação do vírus da gripe está em alta em várias regiões do país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza virus circulation is high in several regions of the country.
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin shows high circulation of Influenza A across Brazil, with SRAG rising in Mato Grosso and most Northeast states (except Piauí) and in the North (Amapá, Pará, Rondônia), and in the Southeast (Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo). Since January 2026, deaths among SRAG patients have been attributed to SARS-CoV-2 (37.3%), influenza A (28.6%), rhinovirus (21.8%), RSV (4.5%), and influenza B (2.5%). In the last four epidemiological weeks, the share among deaths was 30.8% influenza A, 30.8% SARS-CoV-2, 27.5% rhinovirus, 5.5% RSV, and 2.7% influenza B. The Health Ministry outlined three national vaccination strategies for 2026 to broaden coverage and reduce immunopreventable diseases. The influenza vaccination campaign for the Northeast, Central-West, South and Southeast runs March 28–May 30, with Day D on March 28, 2026. An RSV vaccine is available for pregnant women, and influenza A vaccination starts March 28 for priority groups.

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു;15,000 പക്ഷികളെ ഇന്ന് കൊന്നൊടുക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu confirmed; 15,000 birds will be culled today.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu confirmed in Kozhikode district, Kerala, with a lab-confirmed highly pathogenic H5N1 strain. Authorities will cul 15,000 domestic birds today within a one-kilometer radius of the affected premises across Panangad, Olavanna, Kakkodi, Perumanna, and Nallalam panchayats to halt spread. The culling targets chickens and other poultry in these zones. Under the Animal Husbandry Department, rapid-response teams have been deployed; no human infections have been reported, but health authorities urge heightened vigilance. Transport and sale of poultry from the affected areas are prohibited as surveillance continues. The Health and Animal Husbandry departments are conducting joint assessments. People should avoid touching sick or dead birds; if unusual bird deaths occur, report immediately to a nearby veterinary hospital. No immediate cause for alarm, according to district authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ確認；本日15,000羽の鳥を処分予定

triage.notes: H5N1高病原性株の検査確認、5パンチャヤット地域での1km半径内での15,000羽処分、家禽の輸送・販売禁止など、公開衛生対応が既に実施されている。現在のところ人感染報告はないが、人-人感染リスク評価にはさらなる情報が必要。南アジア地域での鳥インフルエンザの拡大懸念から国際的注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 侵入性腦膜炎雙球菌｜徐樂堅稱復活節多留英學生返港　會加強監察
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Invasive meningococcal disease — Xu Lok-ken says more students who stayed in the UK over Easter will return to Hong Kong; monitoring will be strengthened.
article.articleSummary: Invasive meningococcal disease (IMD) is notifiable in Hong Kong. In Kent County, United Kingdom, authorities report at least 29 related IMD cases and 2 deaths, with numbers potentially rising. Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection director Xu Lok-ken notes IMD spreads via close contact in crowded, poorly ventilated settings, with risk behaviors such as sharing drinks among youths. Ahead of Easter, many Hong Kong students in the UK may return home, prompting strengthened airport screening for fever or respiratory symptoms; information has been shared via the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in London. Close contacts of confirmed cases may receive prophylactic antibiotics; the public is advised to receive meningococcal vaccination to reduce risk. Hong Kong currently has 4 locally acquired IMD cases this year (latest: a 3-year-old boy); 11 cases last year. No epidemiological link between local cases. Authorities will monitor for imported cases; none detected yet.

triage.headline_ja: 侵入性脳膜炎双球菌 — 徐樂堅がイースター時期に英国滞在の多くの学生が香港に帰国することを述べ、監視が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡・重症例あり、予想外の増加、国際的拡大リスク）。英国ケント州での29例・2死亡と明確な事例があり、香港への学生帰国による輸入リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 英国（ケント州）での確認例29例・死亡2例による明らかな集団発生。イースター時期の学生帰国という具体的な国際移動リスク。香港の衛生当局が既に公式対応（空港スクリーニング強化、情報共有）を実施済み。WPRO地域内での二次輸入・拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: In-utero exposure to chikungunya and child morbimortality: a population-based study using linked routine data - Nature Communications
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya exposure in-utero in Brazil is linked to higher long-term morbidity. In a registry-based cohort of infants born 2015–2018, 1,821 exposed and 18,210 unexposed children were followed for all-cause first hospitalization or death up to age 3 years. Adjusted Cox models show a hospitalization hazard ratio of 1.21 (95% CI 1.11–1.36), translating to 37 excess hospitalizations per 1,000 exposed (95% CI 16–64). Intrapartum exposure yielded about a twofold risk (HR 2.08; 95% CI 1.33–3.44), with elevated risk also observed for first- and second-trimester exposure. Evidence for increased mortality was limited. The study demonstrates a persistent hospitalization risk associated with in-utero chikungunya exposure through early childhood in Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠中のチクングニア曝露と小児疾患死亡率：ルーチンデータを用いた集団ベース研究 - Nature Communications
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア曝露による小児への長期的な健康影響を示す重要な疫学研究だが、新たな流行・拡大を示すシグナルではなく、過去の曝露（2015-2018年出生児）の後ろ向き分析である。現在の公衆衛生上の脅威度は限定的だが、妊娠可能女性への健康リスク啓発の観点から継続注視が必要。
triage.notes: Nature Communicationsに掲載された査読済み論文であり、科学的信頼性は高い。ただし、これは2015-2018年の過去の出生児コホートの後ろ向き分析であり、現在進行中の流行や新規発生を示すシグナルではない。チクングニア自体のブラジルでの現在の流行状況については記事から不明。妊娠中の曝露による長期的な児への健康影響（特に入院リスク増加）が示唆されたため、妊娠可能女性への疾患啓発や予防戦略の検討は重要であるが、即座のアウトブレイク対応は必要ではない。

article.articleHeadline: UK meningitis outbreak spurs Easter alert on returnees - RTHK
article.articleSummary: UK meningococcal disease outbreak in Kent prompts Hong Kong to step up health screening ahead of the Easter holiday for students and others returning from the UK. Invasive meningococcal infection is statutorily notifiable in Hong Kong, but tracing a case’s source remains challenging; four HK cases this year are described as unrelated. In the UK, at least 29 cases and two deaths have been reported. Hong Kong authorities will monitor arriving travellers; if fever, breathing difficulties or other symptoms are detected, follow-up will occur. Information on the UK outbreak has been shared with SAR students via the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in London. Director of Health Ronald Lam cites fever, severe headaches and skin spots as key symptoms and urges vaccination and good personal hygiene as preventative measures. The health protection centre continues to watch the situation during the Easter travel period.

triage.headline_ja: 英国髄膜炎アウトブレイクがイースター帰国者への警戒を促す - RTHK
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、複数国への関連イベント、死亡例あり、国際的対応実施中。
triage.notes: 英国ケント州での侵襲性髄膜炭疽菌感染症アウトブレイク（29例以上、死亡2例）がイースター休暇期の国際的な人的移動と関連。香港当局が帰国学生等の健康スクリーニング強化を実施。ヒト-ヒト感染性が高く、国境を越えた感染例が既に報告されている可能性がある。WHOへの通知対象相当。

article.articleHeadline: India culls 20,000 birds after avian flu outbreak | News.az
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreak in Kerala, India prompts culling of over 20,000 birds: 14,228 in Kozhikode and 5,961 in Alappuzha. Highly pathogenic avian influenza confirmed by samples at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal. Culling operations begin Saturday with rapid response teams within a 1-km radius of affected areas. Virus detected only in birds so far; authorities urge the public to report unusual bird deaths. No human cases reported; ongoing poultry outbreak and containment measures emphasize preventing spread. Bird flu can spread quickly among poultry and has prompted repeated containment in recent years. The outbreak remains limited to birds at this stage.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ発生後、インドが20,000羽以上の鳥を殺処分
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（HPAI）の確認された発生であり、複数州での急速な広がりと大規模殺処分が報告されている。IHR基準2項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数満たす。
triage.notes: 現在のところ人間への感染は報告されていないが、高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（HPAI）が確認され、ケララ州とマディヤプラデシュ州の複数地域（コージコード、アラップズハ、インドール地域）で20,000羽以上の殺処分が実施されている。インドは過去数年間、繰り返し鳥インフルエンザの封じ込めに直面しており、本件は動物健康に重大な影響を及ぼしている。人間への感染リスク監視が必須。

article.articleHeadline: പക്ഷിപ്പനി: ഭയം വേണ്ട, ജാഗ്രത മതി. കോഴിക്കോട് ജില്ല കളക്ടറുടെ നേതൃത്വത്തില്‍ യോഗം ചേര്‍ന്നു കണ്‍ട്രോള്‍ റൂം തുറന്നു. 14228 വളര്‍ത്തുപക്ഷികളെ കൊന്നു നശിപ്പിക്കും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird flu: No need to fear, vigilance is enough. A meeting was held under the Kozhikode district collector's leadership, and the control room was opened. 14,228 domestic birds will be culled and disposed of.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) confirmed in poultry across Kozhikode district, Kerala. District Collector Snehil Kumar Singh chaired a meeting and opened a district control room under international and national containment protocols. The outbreak epicenter will trigger culling within a one-kilometre radius, with 14,228 domestic birds to be culled and disposed. In a second phase, birds and products not covered by culling will be located and culled (combining), with the State Animal Husbandry Department, district administration, and local bodies participating. ARTI teams are deployed in Olavanna, Kakodi, Panangad, Perumanna, and Nallalam within corporation limits. Five samples from affected birds tested at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases, Bhopal, confirmed Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza; currently only birds are affected. Movement and sale of birds, eggs, meat, and related products are banned within a 10 km surveillance zone. Safe cooking guidance: heating poultry to 70°C for 3–5 minutes; avoid undercooked products. Hotline: 0495-2762050.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：恐れる必要はなく、警戒が重要。コージコード地区コレクターの指導下で会議が開催され、管理室が開設された。14,228羽の飼育鳥が殺処分される予定。
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（HPAI）がインドのケーラ州コージコード地区で家禽で確認された。複数の州（ケーラ州、マディヤプラデシュ州、タミルナド州）および国際的に関連性のある地域（ナイジェリア）に及ぶ多点検出パターンと、IHR Annex2基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際拡大リスク）により、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 複数地点（5つのARTIチーム展開）での検出、国立高度バイオセーフティ動物疾病研究所での確認検査、地区管理室の開設、14,228羽の大規模殺処分計画など、政府対応の高い警戒態勢が示唆される。人間感染は現在報告されていないが、HPAIの人獣共通感染症リスクは継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatite A e leptospirose preocupam após chuvas em MG - 21/03/2026 - Equilíbrio e Saúde - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A and Leptospirosis Worry After Rains in Minas Gerais - March 21, 2026 - Balance and Health - Folha
article.articleSummary: Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais, reports 248 hepatitis A cases in 2026 as of March 19, up 6,100% from four cases in the same period last year, with Zona da Mata floods contributing to 73 deaths. Hepatitis A spreads via contaminated food, contact, and water. Vaccination has been expanded to pregnant women and to household or sexual contacts of confirmed cases aged 11–39; those exposed to floodwater are not routinely immunized. Minas Gerais state allocated 5,000 doses for Ubá and 10,000 for Juiz de Fora; 17,500 bottles of sodium hypochlorite were dispatched; the federal government supplied kits for 13,500 people and reinforced surveillance. In Ubá, eight flood-related deaths have occurred; leptospirosis is a concern. The city reports 118 suspected leptospirosis cases (as of March 16): 41 under investigation, 57 awaiting results, 19 ruled out; one death confirmed. Leptospirosis can resemble dengue; early antibiotics are advised for flood-exposed patients. Prophylaxis is not routinely recommended locally.

triage.headline_ja: ミナス・ジェライス州の雨水被害後、A型肝炎とレプトスピラ症が懸念される - 2026年3月21日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生率、地域的拡大リスク）。短期間で6,100%の急増と73名の洪水関連死亡、複数の感染症同時発生により、フルRRA対象の明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: 2026年3月の記事（未来日付）。ブラジル・ミナス・ジェライス州での洪水後に3疾患（A型肝炎・レプトスピラ症・デング）が同時多発。A型肝炎は前年同期比6,100%増加（4→248例）。洪水による環境汚染が継続中で、給水・衛生対策が不十分なため長期曝露リスク高い。レプトスピラ症はデングに類似した臨床像を呈するため診断困難で、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Contaminated Water Behind Skin Disease Outbreak In MP's Betul, Says Digvijaya Singh
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of skin diseases, especially itching (scabies), is reported in Danvakheda village, Betul district, Madhya Pradesh (Ghodadongri block). As of 21 March 2026, at least 20 children are affected, presenting with itching, cold, cough and fever. A district medical camp was organized and a medical team dispatched after the issue was noticed on 15 March. Digvijaya Singh links the outbreak to contaminated drinking water, urging immediate government intervention, safe water supplies, and inspection of contamination sources, noting a similar fatal outbreak in Betul about six months earlier. He calls for adequate medical facilities and accountability for officials. CMHO Dr Manoj Hurmade confirmed the response, though the report provides no details of laboratory-confirmed diagnoses.

triage.headline_ja: MP州ベトゥル地区の皮膚病流行は汚染水が原因、ディグビジャヤ・シン氏が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 限定的な地域で症例報告されているが、検査確認がなく情報が不完全。スクリーニング基準1つ以上該当する可能性があるが、疫学情報や公衆衛生影響の詳細が不足しているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は政治家による汚染水原因説の主張に基づいており、検査室確認診断が報告されていない。6ヶ月前の類似の致命的流行の言及あり。患者数20人（小児）は限定的だが、同地域での繰り返し発生は環境衛生上の懸念を示唆。医療体制対応が確認されている。続報で検査確認例の有無と患者数の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: HFMD cases nearly double in Ho Chi Minh City as seasonal peak begins
article.articleSummary: HFMD cases in Ho Chi Minh City surged to 837 in the latest week, up 97.1% from the average, with 7,294 cases this year. Wards Long Huong, Long Dien, and Thuong Tan reported the highest rates (>100 per 100,000). Pediatric hospitals report rising HFMD visits; at Children's Hospital 1, 36 children were treated, with severe cases making up 46% of the total. Although counts have risen, current treatment numbers remain below the same period last year. HCDC warns rapid spread and potential outbreaks, especially in nurseries and schools. Nationwide HFMD remains circulating in most localities; Vietnam recorded more than 107,000 cases in 2025, up about 29% from 2024. HFMD is caused by enteroviruses, mainly affecting children under five, spreading via the digestive tract or contact with bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces. Peaks occur March–May and September–November; prevention emphasizes the 'three clean' principle and early detection; keep sick children at home.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市でHFMD症例がほぼ2倍に増加、季節的ピークが始まる
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による手足口病（HFMD）が複数地域で急速に拡大し、前週比97.1%の急増、小児での重症化率46%、全国107,000症例超と既に大規模流行が進行中。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Enterovirus 71は重症合併症（脳炎、急性弛緩性麻痺など）のリスクがあり、特に乳幼児に対する脅威が高い。重症化率46%は懸念される。2025年全国107,000症例超は前年比29%増で拡大傾向。保育所・学校での集団発生リスク指摘あり。リージョナルスケールでの監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Một con chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn chủ nhà và 5 người khác
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dog suspected of having rabies bites the homeowner and five other people
article.articleSummary: On 21 March 2026, Dak Lak Department of Health ordered urgent rabies prevention in Ea Na commune, Krong Ana district. Ea Na Health Station reported that on 20 March six Thanh Cong villagers were bitten by a dog suspected of rabies owned by the family of Mr. D.H.Q. In February, a suspected rabid dog died and was buried. On 15 March the remaining dog bit two of Mr. Q’s daughters, then Mr. Q and three neighbors. On 18 March the dog was killed and buried. The dog also bit three dogs; samples were taken and awaiting results. Dak Lak CDC, Krong Ana District Health Center, and Ea Na Health Station arranged post-exposure vaccination at Tay Nguyen Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology; six victims were vaccinated. Three bitten dogs were detained from 19 March. Officials note rabies risk due to roaming pets and urge a pet census, vaccination compliance, and tighter controls.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の疑いがある犬が家主と5人を咬む
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで確認された狂犬病疑い例による複数人への咬傷事件。人獣共通感染症であり、6名が曝露・予防接種を受けており、公衆衛生上の対応が実施されている。狂犬病は致死的疾患であり、国際的な監視対象。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は単発事例であるが、複数人（6名）が咬傷により曝露し、予防接種対応が実施されている。動物も3頭が咬傷を受けており、ペット管理の課題が指摘されている。WPROスクリーニング基準において重症度（狂犬病の高致死率）・感染しやすさ（人獣共通感染、複数頭動物の関与）で該当。ベトナムの公式保健当局が対応を実施しており管理可能性も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: பறவைக் காய்ச்சல்: சுகாதரத்துறை அறிவுறுத்தல்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bird Flu: Health Department Advisory!
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (bird flu) advisory issued by the Tamil Nadu Health Department after confirmation in birds at Guindy Park. Workers at meat shops should remain vigilant. There have been no human cases in Tamil Nadu to date. Human symptoms include cough, cold, fever, and breathing difficulties; those with such symptoms should not self-medicate and must promptly seek care from a government doctor. The advisory urges the public not to panic and notes that no human infection has been reported in the state. Information on infection source or any imported/exported cases is not provided. Public health measures emphasize surveillance, safe handling of birds, and timely medical consultation.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：保健局からの警告
triage.triage_reason: タミルナドゥ州ギンディ公園で鳥からの鳥インフルエンザ確認により保健局が警告を発出。現時点で人への感染報告はないが、人畜共通感染症であり動物への確認が得られているため、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 現時点でタミルナドゥ州での人への感染事例は報告されていない。鳥での確認に基づく警告であり、対応は適切に実施されている。ただし鳥インフルエンザはヒト感染ポテンシャルが高く、動物での確認と保健当局の警告発出という異常・予想外な事象のため、継続的な情報監視が必要。感染源、輸入・輸出事例に関する情報は提供されていない。

article.articleHeadline: สธ.เผยไข้หวัดใหญ่ปี 69 พบแนวโน้มผู้ป่วยเพิ่มขึ้นกว่าปีที่ผ่าน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MoPH: Influenza in year 69 shows a rising trend in patients compared with the previous year.
article.articleSummary: Influenza in Thailand shows rising activity in 2026 (Year 69 of the Thai calendar). From Jan 1 to Mar 9, 2569, cumulative cases reached 137,276 with 8 deaths. The Department of Disease Control, Ministry of Public Health, notes influenza spreads easily via droplets from coughing/sneezing and contact with infected secretions. The highest affected group is children aged 0–14; although weekly cases have begun to decline, the total remains above the five-year average, with a mid-year resurgence anticipated due to seasonality. Most fatalities are among the elderly or those with underlying conditions who were not vaccinated. Public health advice emphasizes hygiene, including handwashing, wearing masks when ill, and avoiding crowded places to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: タイ保健省：2026年（タイ暦69年）のインフルエンザは前年比で患者数が増加傾向を示している
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの季節的増加傾向が確認されているが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当が不明確であり、また国際的拡大やWHO通知に相当する異常性が現時点では判断困難なため。
triage.notes: タイにおけるインフルエンザの季節的増加は予想可能な現象であり、死亡数（8件）も比較的限定的。ただし患者数137,276件は注視対象で、今後の推移次第ではPICKUPへの昇格あり。WPRO基準で3項目該当するが、IHR基準での該当が限定的なためWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Đắk Lắk khẩn trương phòng, chống bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dak Lak Urgently Ramp Up Rabies Prevention and Control
article.articleSummary: Rabies prevention and control measures were escalated in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, after six deaths suspected from dog bites were reported in Ea Na commune. On 21 March 2026, the Dak Lak Department of Health issued an urgent dispatch mandating Ea Na to conduct a census of dogs and cats, require households to commit to confining pets, and coordinate with veterinary authorities to achieve high rabies vaccination coverage. The provincial Center for Disease Control will assess risk factors including animal population management, vaccination rates, exposure ranges, and potential new exposures, guiding a synchronized outbreak response with environmental sanitation, disinfection, and source control. A 2026 rabies plan had been issued earlier in March. In 2025 Dak Lak recorded 7 rabies cases with deaths, down from 9 in 2024; Vietnam still reports about 70–100 rabies deaths annually per WHO, underscoring vaccination as the key preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: ダクラク州が狂犬病の予防と対策を緊急に強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムダクラク州で犬咬傷に関連する6件の死亡疑い例が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が認められる。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当するため、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ベトナムは年間70～100件の狂犬病死亡を報告しており、Ea Na地域における6件の死亡疑い例は同州における異常な集積を示唆。急速な政府対応（犬猫の国勢調査、飼育制限、ワクチン接種計画）が実施されている。ただし国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限のリスクについては現時点では評価できない。

article.articleHeadline: 英肯特郡爆腦膜炎群組　衞生署：留意入境人士有否病徵
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningitis cluster in Kent, England; Department of Health: Monitor inbound travellers for symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Kent, England reports a cluster of invasive meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) with 29 infections to date and two fatalities. Hong Kong has also recorded a recent imported case involving a 3-year-old boy. In HK, invasive meningococcal disease is a statutory notifiable disease, and authorities note that tracing the infection source is difficult. With Easter holidays approaching, many Hong Kong students studying in the UK may return home; the Department of Health will increase monitoring at airports for symptoms, and information has been distributed to students via the London Office. UK health officials say the outbreak likely originated from a gathering of young people, with risk amplified by crowded, poorly ventilated settings and sharing drinks. In HK, 11 cases were reported last year and 4 this year; the current HK cases are not epidemiologically linked. Symptoms include sudden fever, severe headache, and rash; advice is to maintain hygiene and seek prompt medical care if symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 英肯特郡爆腦膜炎群組　衞生署：留意入境人士有否病徵
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限可能性）かつWPRO基準複数該当。英国での大規模集団発生と香港への輸入症例確認により、地域的リスク上昇。
triage.notes: 複数国（英国・香港・中国）にわたる事例報告。英国では29症例・死亡2名の明確な集団発生。香港では輸入症例確認と港湾監視体制の構築。ヒト-ヒト感染性が高く、若年層の集会環境での拡大リスク。復活祭に伴う香港学生の帰国時期と合致し、国際移動がリスク要因となっている。

article.articleHeadline: 如何应对春季麻疹发病？被狗咬伤后应该如何科学处置？已婚女性需要接种HPV疫苗吗？权威解答来了 - 欧洲头条
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How to deal with springtime measles outbreaks? How should you scientifically manage a dog bite after being bitten? Should married women get the HPV vaccine? The authoritative answer is here - Europe Headlines.
article.articleSummary: As of March 21, 2026, China faces spring measles concerns despite high domestic MMR vaccination; global outbreaks and border countries' resurgences raise importation risk. The National Health Commission urges sustaining routine immunizations, conducting catch-up vaccinations for weakly covered areas, and parents to verify children’s vaccination records; travelers to high-risk regions should check immunization and may receive one MMR dose 21 days before departure. Rabies remains a nearly fatal zoonosis worldwide, with post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) nearly 100% effective when started promptly. After a dog or cat bite, rinse the wound with clean water/soap for about 15 minutes and seek medical care for full PEP; minimize contact with pets, especially for pregnant women, infants, the elderly, or those with allergies, and ensure pets are vaccinated. HPV vaccine can prevent at least 70% of cervical cancers; vaccination is prioritized for pre-sexual debut individuals, with nationwide inclusion in the immunization program in 2025 and free vaccination for 13-year-old girls starting in 2026. Debunked myths: marriage status does not negate vaccination, and vaccination does not replace cervical cancer screening (ages 35–64).

triage.headline_ja: 春季麻疹の対策方法は？犬に咬まれた後の科学的な対処方法は？既婚女性はHPVワクチンを接種すべきか？権威ある回答がここに - ヨーロッパヘッドライン
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹と狂犬病という2つの重大感染症が中国で同時に言及され、麻疹については春季発生懸念と国際的流行リスク、狂犬病については高い致命率が記述されている。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・公衆衛生への影響が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（麻疹の海外発生、狂犬病の高致命率）と流行性が確認されたため。
triage.notes: 記事は公式な公衆衛生情報（国家衛生委員会による指針）を含んでいる。麻疹は春季の季節性発生リスク、国境諸国での再流行、国際流行地域への渡航リスクが明記されている。狂犬病は接触動物からの曝露リスクが継続的に存在する。HPVワクチンに関する記述も含まれるが、感染症危機とは関連性が低い。麻疹と狂犬病の2疾患が併記されたシグナルとして重要。

article.articleHeadline: பறவை காய்ச்சல் எதிரொலி: "இறைச்சி கூடத்தில் பணிபுரிபவர்கள் கவனத்துடன் பணி செய்யுங்கள்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian Influenza Aftermath: "Slaughterhouse Workers, Work Carefully."
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza confirmed in birds at Chennai's Kindi Children’s Park, leading to a temporary park closure. Tamil Nadu health officials report no human infections to date and urge calm. Residents of Chennai and surrounding areas should handle animals and birds with precautions. Individuals with cough, cold, fever, or breathing difficulties should seek medical care promptly. People who handle sick or dead birds or work in meat processing should exercise caution. Any unusual bird deaths should be reported to the Veterinary Department immediately. Avoid consuming undercooked eggs or meat and steer clear of areas with infected birds. Meat shop workers should not dump meat waste in public areas. Do not believe rumors; for more information, contact 104.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザの後続対応：「食肉処理場労働者は注意深く作業してください」
triage.triage_reason: インドのタミルナドゥ州チェンナイで鳥インフルエンザがヒトから鳥への伝播確認され、異常性、重症度リスク、長期曝露可能性が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: チェンナイのKindi Children's Parkで鳥インフルエンザが確認され、当該施設が一時的に閉園。現時点で人への感染は報告されていないが、タミルナドゥ州保健局が注意喚起を実施。食肉処理場労働者など高リスク職業従事者への具体的警告あり。ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、長期曝露可能性、国内外への拡大可能性が存在する。
