article.articleHeadline: 英國腦炎疫情讓香港緊張 港衛生官員擔心留英學生帶回病毒 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UK encephalitis outbreak puts Hong Kong on edge as health officials worry that students who studied in the UK will bring the virus back.
article.articleSummary: Invasive meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) linked to a serogroup B outbreak in Kent, United Kingdom has Hong Kong on alert ahead of Easter, as many Hong Kong youths study in the UK. As of 20 March 2026, Hong Kong reported four invasive meningococcal infections this year, all with no travel history during incubation; authorities say there is no evidence these HK cases are linked to the UK outbreak. The government will monitor potential transmission via returning students during the Easter period, including airport screening for fever or respiratory symptoms. The Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office has notified local students studying in the UK about the situation. The latest local case is a 3-year-old boy with meningitis in severe condition. Common symptoms include sudden fever, severe headache, and rash; health authorities urge prompt medical care and heightened vigilance for imported/exported case dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: 英国脳炎疫情が香港を緊張させる　港衛生当局者は英国留学生がウイルスを持ち帰ることを懸念
triage.triage_reason: 侵襲性髄膜炎菌性疾患（血清群B）の英国（ケント州）での発生が複数国で確認され、香港では当地での症例報告と輸入ケースのリスクが存在。国際的な学生移動による伝播リスクと地域間の関連性の可能性があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準で複数該当。
triage.notes: 複数国（英国・香港・中国）での報告。血清群Bの侵襲性髄膜炎菌性疾患は高死亡率・高罹患率。香港では留学生帰国時期（イースター休暇）での輸入ケース懸念が高まっており、空港検疫の実施予定など当局の警戒レベルが上昇。現地の4症例と英国アウトブレイクの因果関係は未確認だが、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 2 more suspected food poisoning cases linked to fermented fish in Da Nang
article.articleSummary: As of 21 March 2026, Da Nang reports two additional suspected cases of fermented-fish–related food poisoning linked to Ca u chua, a Quang Nam highlands delicacy made from fermented freshwater fish with rice, salt and spices. Patients were hospitalized on Wednesday and Friday and are under care at Phuoc Son Regional Medical Center. Authorities urge hospitals to mobilize intensive-care resources, plan inter-hospital consultations, and coordinate with higher-level facilities to minimize risk. The Vietnam Food Safety Authority has asked Da Nang’s health department to trace ingredients, collect samples, and test food and patient specimens; violations will be punished. Public awareness campaigns warn against handmade fermented fish lacking hygiene and preservation standards. Earlier this month, three children in Phuoc Nang suffered botulinum poisoning after eating fermented fish, prompting WHO to supply Botulism Antitoxin Heptavalent vials (not stored domestically). Vietnam has previously received antidotes from WHO in 2020 and 2023.

triage.headline_ja: ダナン市における塩辛魚の発酵食品関連食中毒の追加事例2件を報告
triage.triage_reason: ボツリヌス菌毒素による食中毒事例が複数発生し、入院患者を含む重症度がある。WHOから抗毒素供給を受けており、国際的な公衆衛生対応が開始されている。IHR基準およびWPRO基準で複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ボツリヌス毒素中毒は致死的な可能性のある疾患。同月初旬に3人の小児患者が発生しており、既に複数事例の集積がある。WHOが抗毒素（7価血清）を供給し、2020年・2023年の過去対応実績がある。ベトナム食品安全局による調査が開始され、国内対応が進行中。手作り発酵食品の衛生基準に関する公衆衛生的な懸念が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Chó nghi dại cắn bố con chủ nhà và 3 hàng xóm, Đắk Lắk hỏa tốc phòng chống bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected rabid dog bites the homeowner's father and son and three neighbors; Dak Lak launches urgent rabies prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Six people in Thanh Cong hamlet, Ea Na commune, Dak Lak Province, were bitten by a dog suspected of rabies in March 2026. The dog, previously behaving abnormally, attacked two daughters on March 15–16, then the owner, and three more neighbors on March 17; three other dogs in the area were also bitten. The animal was killed and buried; a lab sample was collected awaiting confirmation. Dak Lak Department of Health issued an urgent dispatch to strengthen rabies prevention and control, coordinating with the Krông Ana District Center for Disease Control and the Ea Na Health Station for treatment guidance. By March 20, all six bite victims had received rabies vaccines, five of them also receiving rabies immunoglobulin as indicated. Authorities are tracing exposures, increasing surveillance, and promoting vaccination and responsible pet ownership to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 疑いのある狂犬病の犬が家主の父と息子および3人の隣人を咬む、ダクラク州が緊急の狂犬病予防・対策を開始
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は重篤な感染症だが、本イベントは限定的な地域での動物由来感染で、既に適切な対応（被咬者への迅速なワクチン接種・免疫グロブリン投与、動物の殺処分、検査体制確立）が進行中。現時点では国際的拡大リスクや管理困難性の明確な証拠に欠けるため、続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致命的な疾患だが、本件は地域的かつ動物由来で人-人感染なし。6名の被咬者全員が既にワクチン接種済み、対症療法が確立している。ダクラク州保健局が積極的に対応中。動物検査結果の確認待ち。フルRRAの条件に達していないが、狂犬病は重篇な疾患のため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Một con chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn chủ nhà và 5 người khác
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dog suspected of having rabies bit the homeowner and five others.
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk in Dak Lak, Vietnam: A dog suspected of rabies owned by a family in Thanh Cong hamlet, Ea Na commune, Krông Ana district, attacked six people—the homeowner and five others. An earlier dog from the same household died in February and was buried in the garden. On March 15 the remaining dog showed abnormal behavior and bit the owner's two daughters; it also bit the homeowner and three neighbors before being killed on March 18 and buried. Samples were taken for testing; results were pending. Dak Lak CDC, Krông Ana Health Center, and Ea Na Health Station directed victims to receive rabies vaccination at the Tay Nguyen Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology; all six victims have been vaccinated. The three dogs bitten were seized for monitoring since March 19. Officials warn rabies risk from roaming, unvaccinated pets and urge strengthened vaccination and animal-control measures in Ea Na.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の疑いのある犬が家の主人と他の5人を噛んだ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の疑いが強い動物咬傷事件であり、複数の人的被害（6名）と接触者監視が発生しているが、検査結果が未定、死亡例なし、国際的拡大リスクが限定的であるため。
triage.notes: 狂犬病確定診断がまだであり（検査結果未定）、被咬傷者6名は全員ワクチン接種済み、接触動物3頭は隔離監視中。ベトナム国内での散発的な動物由来感染症として、地域の公衆衛生当局が適切に対応中。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、狂犬病の確定診断如何では判定が変わる可能性あり。続報注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: World Tuberculosis Day 2026: Early warning signs of TB you should never ignore
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, remains a global infectious disease with India highlighted as a key prevalence region. The article, published on 2026-03-21 for World Tuberculosis Day 2026, emphasizes early warning signs and the need for prompt medical evaluation. Core symptoms include a persistent cough lasting more than 2–3 weeks (with phlegm or blood), fatigue, unintentional weight loss, night sweats, low-grade fevers, and loss of appetite. These signs are often misattributed to flu, allergies, pollution, or stress, delaying diagnosis. Early diagnosis and effective treatment are crucial to prevent lung damage and curb transmission, aided by advances in diagnostic technologies and laboratory confirmation. While TB can affect organs beyond the lungs, the lungs remain primary targets. The article highlights awareness and access to care but provides no case counts or details on imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: World Tuberculosis Day 2026: Early warning signs of TB you should never ignore
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は世界結核デーの啓発記事であり、結核とインフルエンザの新規発生、アウトブレイク、または異常な流行パターンを報告するものではない。具体的な症例数、感染動向、または公衆衛生上の危機を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 本記事は3月24日の世界結核デーに関連する教育啓発コンテンツ（症状認識と早期診断の重要性に関する一般向け情報）であり、感染症の新規発生、クラスター、またはアウトブレイクを報告していない。Bluedot自動検出により結核とインフルエンザがタグ付けされているが、これは記事の主題がこれらの疾患であることを反映しているのみである。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Chó dại cắn 6 người, tiêu hủy khẩn vật nuôi của 11 hộ dân
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabid dog bites six people; emergency euthanization of pets belonging to 11 households.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 March 2026, six residents in Thanh Cong hamlet, Ea Na Commune, Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, were bitten by a dog suspected of rabies. The dog had shown signs in early February and died; on 15 March it harmed six people (three from the Q family and three local residents) and also attacked three neighboring dogs. The six bite victims received timely rabies vaccination and remain stable with no abnormal symptoms. Authorities captured and quarantined the biting dog, which later tested positive for rabies. In response, Ea Na authorities euthanized 11 dogs belonging to neighboring households and confined more than 200 other local dogs for vaccination and monitoring. Background: Dak Lak reported seven rabies deaths in 2025, highlighting ongoing transmission risk in the province.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病犬が6人を咬傷、11世帯のペットを緊急安楽死
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の確定例（動物）と人的被害（6名咬傷）が報告されているが、被害者全員が迅速にワクチン接種され安定状態にあり、現時点では重篤な人的影響は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は高い致死率の人獣共通感染症であり、地域での確定例報告は重要。ダク・ラク省における2025年の死亡例（7例）が背景にあり、地域的な伝播リスクが存在する。ただし本事例では被害者全員がワクチン接種され安定しており、当局の対応も迅速（動物の隔離・安楽死、住民への予防接種）。今後の患者発生状況や地域的な流行拡大の情報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: India's TB burden is also an AMR warning signal
article.articleSummary: India bears the largest share of global tuberculosis and MDR/RR-TB, accounting for about a quarter of global TB cases in 2024, per WHO's Global TB Report 2025. Despite a 21% decline in incidence from 2015 to 2023 (to roughly 187 cases per 100,000 in 2023; 195 per 100k in 2022), elimination targets of 44 per 100,000 by 2025 remain distant. Drug-resistant TB—driven by antimicrobial resistance—poses a major challenge: India hosts nearly one-third of the world’s MDR and rifampicin-resistant TB cases. Treatment for resistant TB is longer (often 9–18 months) and uses second-line drugs with greater toxicities, emphasizing the need for rapid molecular diagnostics (e.g., NAATs) to detect resistance and start appropriate therapy. Achieving shorter, fully oral regimens requires reliable procurement, trained clinicians, and robust surveillance under the National TB Elimination Programme and the National Action Plan on AMR.

triage.headline_ja: インドのTB負担は抗菌薬耐性(AMR)の警告信号でもある
triage.triage_reason: インドの結核・多剤耐性結核の高い疾病負担は重要だが、新規アウトブレイク情報ではなく疾病負担の定期的な報告であり、直近の国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠に欠ける。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: WHOの2025年グローバルTBレポートに基づく既知の疾病負担の分析報告であり、新規アウトブレイク検知ではない。IHR基準の国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクは現時点では不明確。多剤耐性結核(MDR/RR-TB)と抗菌薬耐性(AMR)の継続的な監視は重要であるが、シグナルトリアージの段階では追加情報待機が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará confirma terceiro caso de Mpox em 2026 e já soma 29 notificações da doença - Contexto Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará confirms third Mpox case in 2026 and already has 29 disease notifications - Contexto Notícias
article.articleSummary: Ceará, Brazil confirms 3 Mpox cases in 2026 with 29 notifications (3 confirmed, 24 discarded, 2 under investigation). The third case was confirmed on March 20, 2026, via IntegraSUS. Before this update, Ceará had two Mpox cases in February; the first confirmed case was disclosed March 9 involving a male patient, with confirmation also reported March 10 by CNIES. Ongoing epidemiological surveillance continues to identify new infections. Mpox transmission is primarily via direct contact with skin lesions and secretions; prolonged close exposure can spread respiratory droplets and other bodily fluids. No age or sex details are provided for the latest case. Data reflect continuous monitoring and case classification in the state's public health dashboard.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州が2026年にハンタウイルス感染症の3番目の症例を確認し、既に29件の通知が累積 - Contexto Notícias
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でのMpox症例の段階的確認であり、異常性と継続的な曝露リスクが認められるが、現在のところ重症度や国際的拡大の明確な証拠が記事内に不足している。続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: Mpoxは既知の感染症であるが、ブラジル・セアラ州での段階的な症例確認と29件の通知件数は地域内での継続的な流行の可能性を示唆している。重症度情報、患者の年齢・性別、臨床転帰が不足しており、より詳細な情報が必要。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が言及されている点も評価要因。

article.articleHeadline: 英脑膜炎球菌感染扩大 香港加强防疫避免输入病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UK meningococcal infection on the rise; Hong Kong strengthens epidemic prevention to prevent imported cases.
article.articleSummary: Kent, United Kingdom reports an outbreak of invasive meningococcal disease expanding from 20 to 29 cases, with two student deaths. Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection (CHP) is strengthening border controls and airport health screening to prevent imported cases as HK students may return for Easter. CHP says there is no confirmed link to HK students yet but will issue health information and guidance via the Hong Kong Economic and Trade Office in London. Airport surveillance is intensified; suspected travelers are screened and referred to hospital. Doctors are alerted to travelers from affected areas and advised on vaccination based on age, health, and travel. The CHP advisory committee found meningococcal vaccination not routine in HK due to very low incidence, but high-risk individuals should follow destination guidelines. This year HK has four cases; last year 11; symptoms include meningitis and septicemia; seek care early if symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: 英脳膜炎球菌感染拡大 香港は輸入病例回避のため防疫強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。侵襲性髄膜炎菌感染の集団発生で複数国境地域への拡大懸念があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ケント州での侵襲性髄膜炎菌病の拡大（20→29例、学生2名死亡）は明らかに異常事象。ヒト-ヒト感染が可能な病原体であり、香港など複数国での防疫強化措置が既に発動。イースター休暇による学生の越境移動がリスク。WPRO全基準に該当し、国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cólera matou mais de 480 pessoas neste ano em África - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera killed more than 480 people this year in Africa - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-03-21, Africa CDC reports 484 cholera deaths this year, with 18,500 suspected and 5,300 confirmed cases, yielding a case fatality rate of 2.03% aimed to drop to 1%. Mozambique records 7,773 cases and 82 deaths from 3 Sep 2025 to 19 Mar 2026, while Angola has logged 36,536 cases since January 2025, including 19,684 males and 16,582 females, as of 20 Feb 2026. The continent’s most affected countries are the Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, and Nigeria. South Sudan declared the outbreak over on 5 March but remains under surveillance to prevent resurgence, as Rwanda and Zimbabwe have experienced. In 2025 Africa reported about 262,300 confirmed cases and 5,900 deaths from cholera, according to Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: コレラがアフリカで今年480人以上を殺害 - O País - ニュースとしての真実
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な多国家同時発生、国際的拡大リスク）。複数アフリカ諸国での継続的なコレラ流行で、死亡者数が既に484人に達し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性が全て該当する。
triage.notes: 2025年のアフリカ全体で262,300確定例・5,900死亡が報告されており、2026年も484死亡に達している。モザンビーク（82死亡）、アンゴラ（36,536例）、DRC、南スーダン、ナイジェリアなど複数国で同時流行中。南スーダンは3月5日に終息宣言したが監視継続中。Case fatality rateは2.03%で、目標1%への低減課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: Artificial intelligence helping healthcare experts find more TB and other diseases in Thai hospitals
article.articleSummary: Thailand’s 2024 TB burden is about 104,000 people with TB disease; diagnosis and treatment reach ~81,700, leaving ~22,300 undiagnosed. The 2023–2024 TB decline of 2% is insufficient to end TB by 2030. Thailand remains a high-burden TB and TB-HIV nation; drug-resistant TB is no longer among the highest-burden. Upfront molecular testing rose to 69% in 2024 (global 54%), with a 2027 target to replace microscopy. AI-assisted screening boosts early detection, including asymptomatic TB. Genki AI (DeepTek) received Thailand FDA approval in 2022 for chest X-ray interpretation across 27 pathologies, including TB, and is cleared by US FDA and other regulators. In Chonburi’s Aikchol Hospital, radiologist Dr Grisit Prueksaritanond uses Genki AI; over 1,000 chest X-rays yearly; it helped avoid missing 3 TB-related lesions and aids detection of other lung abnormalities. WHO endorsed AI CAD in 2021 to bridge the missing millions in TB detection.

triage.headline_ja: 人工知能がタイの病院のTBおよび他の疾患をより多く発見するのに役立つ
triage.triage_reason: TB-HIV高負担国であるタイにおいて、AI技術による診断改善に関するテクノロジー記事。疾患検出率向上に関連する肯定的な事例報道だが、新規感染爆発やアウトブレイク、予期しない疫学的変化の報告ではなく、既知の高負担疾患への対策に関する記事。情報不足のため要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はAI診断技術の導入成功事例。タイの既知のTB-HIV高負担状況への対処を扱っており、新規アウトブレイク警告ではない。未診断症例22,300人の存在が指摘されているが、これは既知の問題である。技術的進展と既存診断ギャップの課題に関する報道。

article.articleHeadline: Altas temperaturas favorecem mosquito da dengue; veja como prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High temperatures favor the dengue-carrying mosquito; see how to prevent.
article.articleSummary: High temperatures in São Paulo state heighten dengue risk as Aedes aegypti breeding accelerates in standing water; SES-SP urges elimination of potential breeding sites inside and around homes, noting that even small water-filled containers can sustain mosquito reproduction. Weekly home inspections are emphasized to reduce risk and prevent new dengue cases. As of March 17, 2026, 15,744 dengue cases and 6 deaths have been confirmed in the state; chikungunya totals reach 315 cases and 2 deaths. Disease surveillance continues via the Arboviruses Panel dashboards for Dengue and Chikungunya. Dengue symptoms typically begin abruptly and last 5–7 days. The Government of São Paulo launched the Dengue 100 Dúvidas portal to dispel misinformation and guide the public about dengue, zika, and chikungunya, available at www.dengue100duvidas.sp.gov.br.

triage.headline_ja: 高温がデング熱蚊を助長；予防方法を参照
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州でデング熱、チクングニア、ジカの同時流行が報告され、2026年3月17日時点で15,744件のデング熱確定患者と6人の死亡が確認されている。IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を複数満たし、WPRO基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）も該当する。
triage.notes: 3つの蚊媒介ウイルス（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）の同時流行であり、政府が専門ポータルサイトを立ち上げて対応している。高温による蚊の繁殖加速が明示されており、季節的リスク要因も存在する。デング死亡率（6/15,744≈0.04%）は比較的低いが、感染者数が急増している可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: India arah pelupusan 20,000 unggas di Kerala susulan penularan selesema burung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: India orders the culling of 20,000 poultry in Kerala following avian influenza transmission.
article.articleSummary: Bird flu outbreak in Kerala, India prompts culling of over 20,000 poultry. Authorities began a culling operation on Saturday within a one-kilometer radius of affected sites to contain avian influenza transmission. Containment efforts are led by officials in the Kozhikode and Alappuzha districts, where poultry infections have been reported. The report, citing local media via Xinhua, frames the measures as part of an ongoing response to the outbreak in southern Kerala. No human cases or infection sources are detailed beyond the poultry outbreak. The action highlights rapid-response culling as a key containment strategy. Published March 21, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: インドがケーラ州での鳥インフルエンザ感染を受けて20,000羽の家禽の殺処分を命令
triage.triage_reason: インドケーラ州での鳥インフルエンザ発生に伴う20,000羽以上の家禽殺処分は、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では複数項目が満たされるため、シグナルとしてピックアップする。
triage.notes: ケーラ州での複数地域（コジコード、アラップズハ）での家禽感染が確認されており、当局が即座に1km圏内での殺処分を実施。現時点で人への感染は報告されていないが、鳥インフルエンザの人獣共通感染リスクと地理的拡大の可能性について継続監視が必要。南部ケーラの鳥インフルエンザの継続的流行状況の把握が重要。

article.articleHeadline: ETV Bharat Impact: NHRC Calls For ATR On Rising Chickenpox Cases In Kozhikode
article.articleSummary: January 2026 saw Kerala report 3,300 chickenpox cases in the first 24 days, with Kozhikode emerging as a major hotspot (430 January cases, more than double December’s 210). In response, the National Human Rights Commission issued a notice and sought a time-bound action taken report (ATR) from Kerala Health Secretary within four weeks, with a hearing after four weeks. The NHRC order follows ETV Bharat’s report highlighting a sustained rise in cases and situating Kozhikode as a focal point in a broader year-on-year increase (2023: 26,390; 2024: 27,106; 2025: 29,055). The Commission underscored links between infectious disease control and the right to life and health, raising concerns about district public health infrastructure, early warning and surveillance, vaccination, isolation, timely care, and public awareness. A copy of the complaint was transmitted to the Kerala Secretary, Health and Family Welfare.

triage.headline_ja: ETV Bharat Impact: NHRC Calls For ATR On Rising Chickenpox Cases In Kozhikode
triage.triage_reason: インドケーララ州コージコード地区における水痘患者数の急増が報告され、国家人権委員会（NHRC）が介入。IHR基準で異常性・予想外性が明確であり、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常/予想外性、重症度との関連性、政府レベルの関心が確認される。
triage.notes: 2026年1月の24日間でケーララ州は3,300件の水痘症例を報告。コージコード地区は430件（1月）で12月の210件から倍以上に増加。年間ベースでも増加傾向（2023年：26,390件→2024年：27,106件→2025年：29,055件）。NHRCが4週間以内の行動報告書提出を要求し、感染症対策と基本的人権（生存権・健康権）との関連性を指摘。公衆衛生インフラ、早期警戒・監視体制、ワクチン接種、隔離、適切な医療、公衆衛生啓発などに懸念が示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Một con chó nghi dại tấn công liên tiếp 6 người tại Đắk Lắk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A dog suspected of rabies attacked six people in Dak Lak.
article.articleSummary: Six residents in Ea Na commune, Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, were attacked by a dog suspected of rabies. The dog belonged to the family of Mr. D.H.Q. in Thành Công hamlet; after a February incident involving a presumed rabid dog, the remaining dog developed abnormal behavior on March 15 and bit two of Mr. Q’s daughters, then others. The animal was killed and buried in a garden. Buôn Ma Thuột veterinary authorities collected samples and await testing at the Central Highlands Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology. The Krông Ana District Center for Disease Control and Prevention, Ea Na Health Station, and local teams ordered immediate rabies vaccination for all bite victims; five received rabies immunoglobulin. Authorities are monitoring exposed animals, strengthening vaccination outreach, and urging residents not to let pets roam. This year marks the first rabies-exposure cases in Thành Công; rabies is 100% fatal once symptoms appear; seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのダックラック州で狂犬病が疑われる犬が6人を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病という高い致命率を持つ感染症について、複数の人間への直接曝露が確認されており、公衆衛生上の影響は深刻である。異常性も有し、局所的な感染症管理対応が取られている。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は発症後100%致命的であり、6名の咬傷被害者への曝露が確認されている。動物源感染症（zoonosis）として、地域の動物管理と公衆衛生対応が重要。検体がCentral Highlands Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiologyに送付されており、確認検査待機中。地域レベルでの予防接種対応が実施済み。情報源はベトナム地域メディアであり、信頼性が確認できれば優先度が上がる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 6 người bị chó dại cắn, cách ly hơn 200 con vật
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six people bitten by a rabid dog, more than 200 animals quarantined.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam, after six residents were bitten by a rabid dog in Ea Na commune, Thành Công village. An initial dog from the household showed symptoms and died in early February; on March 15 the remaining dog attacked six people (three family members and three locals) and bit three neighboring dogs. All six bite victims received rabies vaccines. Authorities captured and isolated three dogs that were bitten to monitor them. The dog that caused the incident died and tested positive for rabies in laboratory confirmation. Local authorities culled 11 neighboring dogs and quarantined and vaccinated more than 200 dogs in the area to prevent transmission. As of March 21, the six bite victims are in stable condition with no abnormal symptoms. Dak Lak Department of Health issued an urgent dispatch to accelerate control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病の犬に咬まれた6人、200頭以上の動物が隔離された
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの狂犬病アウトブレイク（確定例1頭、人間被害6人）であり、IHR基準2項目以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。動物由来感染症の人獣共通感染症が関わる公衆衛生上重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率がほぼ100%の重篤感染症。複数の人間被害（6人）、実験室確定診断、地域内での複数動物感染、当局による積極的な制御対応（200頭以上の予防接種・隔離）が記録されている。狂犬病の拡大予防が適切に実施されているが、監視継続が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Chó dại cắn 6 người, Đăk Lăk cách ly hơn 200 vật nuôi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabid dog bites six people, Dak Lak quarantines more than 200 animals.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak in Dak Lak Province, Vietnam: On March 15, 2026, a dog in Ea Na commune (Thanh Cong village) that had earlier shown rabies symptoms and died triggered human exposures. The remaining dog in the same household attacked six people (three family members and three local residents) and bit three neighboring dogs. Six bite victims were vaccinated for rabies; their conditions are stable with no symptoms to date. When the attacking dog died, laboratory tests confirmed rabies. Local authorities culled 11 dogs from neighboring households and quarantined or observed over 200 dogs in the area to monitor transmission. A rapid health ministry directive issued March 21, 2026, ordered intensified rabies prevention measures in the district as the outbreak is investigated.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病患者の犬が6人を咬傷、ダク・ラク省が200頭以上の動物を隔離
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病アウトブレイク。複数の人間被害（6人咬傷）と広範な動物接触者調査が展開されており、IHR基準2項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準においても異常性・重症度・流行可能性で該当。保健省による緊急指令が発出されている。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威（100%致死率）。複数の人間被害と広範な動物カウンターパート（200頭以上の隔離・観察）により、深刻度は高い。保健省が2026年3月21日に緊急指令を発出し、地区内での予防措置強化が指示されている。国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクは現在のところ低いが、流行制御不備の場合の進展可能性があるため注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 英暴發腦膜炎　香港衞生署加強機場監測　　19:38
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: UK meningitis outbreak; Hong Kong Department of Health steps up airport surveillance 19:38
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-21, Hong Kong reports concern over an invasive meningococcal disease outbreak in southern England, notably Kent, and is intensifying airport screening for inbound travelers with suspected symptoms to enable hospital referral. Hong Kong has recorded 11 invasive meningococcal disease cases last year and 4 so far this year, with the latest case being a 3-year-old boy. Officials say there is no epidemiological link between Hong Kong’s current cases and the UK cluster. Meningococcal disease spreads via respiratory droplets or direct contact with respiratory secretions; symptoms include sudden fever, severe headache, purpuric rash, and potential shock, with fatalities in severe instances. Vaccination is cited as an effective preventive measure, alongside good personal hygiene. The Center for Health Protection notes tracing transmission sources is challenging; airport surveillance and information dissemination to local residents and students via the London office will continue as Easter travel increases.

triage.headline_ja: 英国の脳髄膜炎の流行；香港衛生当局が空港監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。侵襲性髄膜炎菌感染症は国際公衆衛生上の懸念事項であり、複数国での症例報告と空港監視の実施が確認されている。
triage.notes: 英国ケント州での侵襲性髄膜炎菌感染症クラスターが報告され、香港が空港スクリーニング強化を実施。致命率が高く、呼吸器飛沫感染するため国際拡大リスクが高い。ただし現時点で香港の既存症例との疫学的関連は否定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ceará confirma terceiro caso de Mpox este ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ceará confirms third Mpox case this year.
article.articleSummary: Mpox in Ceará, Brazil, records its third case in 2026 as of March 21, with epidemiological monitoring via the Integra SUS platform highlighting ongoing circulation. The state has 29 notified cases this year, of which 3 are confirmed and 24 discarded after specific testing; 2 cases remain under investigation awaiting laboratory results. The first case of the current cycle was reported on March 10, identified by the National Center for Epidemiological Intelligence and Genomic Surveillance (CNIESVG). The earliest documented case in Ceará this year involved a 37-year-old white man with high school education who received medical care and showed favorable recovery. Transmission is primarily through direct, prolonged contact with the skin or secretions, with additional risk from close exposure to respiratory droplets. Laboratory confirmation uses molecular testing or genetic sequencing of material from lesions; samples should be taken from lesion secretions or dry crusts for national reference labs.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州が2026年の3例目のサル痘ケースを確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でMpox確認患者が増加傾向にあり、流行性とヒト-ヒト感染リスクが存在するが、現時点での患者数や重症度情報が限定的であり、国際的な拡大リスク評価に必要な詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: ブラジル・セアラ州における2026年のMpox確認患者数は3例（3月21日時点）で、29件の報告ケースのうち24件は除外、2件が検査中。第1例は3月10日に報告された。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあるため監視継続が必要。ただし、患者の重症度、入院率、死亡率などの詳細情報が記事に記載されていないため、公衆衛生への深刻な影響度や国際的拡大リスクについて判定できない。WPROスクリーニング基準に基づき続報を注視すべき段階と判断。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Guindy Children's park shut for public after 40 birds die of Avian influenza
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza H5N1 prompted the closure of Guindy Children's Park, Chennai, after about 40 birds died in the past week. The first deaths on March 13 occurred in the Vedanthangal wetland aviary inside the park, with 30 birds (24 night herons, 6 pelicans) dying. Samples were sent to AIWC at Vandalur and NIHSAD in Bhopal; results were positive for H5N1. Additional deaths followed on March 14–18: two pelicans, a painted stork and a grey heron. The park closed to the public from Friday as a precaution; relocation to Vandalur Zoo is not possible due to the outbreak. Tests confirm avian influenza; the virus can spread via remains, feathers and droppings, and disinfection is underway with surviving birds observed. Crows in nearby Adyar, Velachery and Thiruvanmiyur also tested positive for H5N1. The 22-acre park houses Vedanthangal Aviary with about 150 birds across 50 species; reopening will occur after repeated negative tests.

triage.headline_ja: ギンディ子供公園、鳥インフルエンザで40羽が死亡後に一般公開を中止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの確認、複数地域での検出（チェンナイ、アディヤル、ベランチェリー等）、野生鳥類での拡大確認、人獣共通感染症との特性からIHR基準3項目該当およびWPRO基準3項目該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: H5N1は高病原性鳥インフルエンザで人獣共通感染症。複数地域（チェンナイ、ヴァンダルール、ボーパル）での検出、死亡野鳥の増加、公園閉鎖という公衆衛生措置が実施されている。野生鳥類での検出は国際的拡散リスク（渡航鳥類）が高い。情報源は信頼できる報道機関（UNI India）。

article.articleHeadline: Độc tố Botulinum rình rập từ món ủ chua ở vùng cao Quảng Ngãi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Botulinum toxin lurks in a fermented dish in the highlands of Quảng Ngãi.
article.articleSummary: Botulinum toxin poisoning (Clostridium botulinum neurotoxin) linked to homemade cá muối chua and other fermented foods in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam. In the last nine months, five cases have been treated at Quảng Ngãi General Hospital 2, all associated with traditional fermentation; three cases from Kon Plông in 2025 were mild and managed with supportive care. On 7 March 2026, three Da Nang children (ages 15, 11, and 7) developed fatigue, weakness, and dysphagia after consuming cá ủ chua and were admitted on 8 March; laboratory-confirmed botulinum poisoning. Vietnam faced antitoxin shortages, prompting WHO to ship five vials from Geneva via Istanbul to Hanoi and Da Nang on 11 March to aid treatment. A separate 6 March 2026 case involved two spouses from Đắk Pék, with the male progressing to quadriplegia and requiring ventilation, now improving under intensive care. Authorities warn about risks from traditional fermented foods and improperly preserved canned foods, stressing safe preparation and early symptom recognition.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのクアンガイ高地地域での発酵食品に潜むボツリヌム毒素
triage.triage_reason: 複数国での確定症例（ベトナム5例、うち重症例あり）、国際支援の必要性（WHOの抗毒素供給）、死亡リスクを伴う重篤な神経障害疾患であり、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: ボツリヌス中毒は神経障害性疾患として死亡リスクが高く、集団発生の可能性がある。従来的な発酵食品製造との関連が明確。WHOによる抗毒素供給がジュネーブ経由で実施されており、国際的対応が既に開始されている。記事内容は確実な症例確認と医療対応を記述しており、情報の信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Global Dengue Cases Doubled In 2024 From 2023 To 12 Million; Study Links Surge To Extreme Rain From Climate Breakdown
article.articleSummary: Global dengue cases reached 12 million in 2024, doubling 2023’s 6.5 million and causing more than 6,800 deaths, with record outbreaks across South America including Brazil and Peru. A One Earth study by researchers from the United States, Peru, and Ecuador attributes about 60% of cases in the most affected regions to the torrential rains from Cyclone Yaku plus a strong El Niño. Using a novel attribution method that compares regions with extreme precipitation to climate-mimicking controls, the researchers link climate change to higher risk of warm, unusually wet conditions in northwestern Peru, fueling an unprecedented outbreak that killed over 380 people in six months. They estimate the cyclone amplified cases to roughly tenfold above the historic average; without it, 2023–2024 would still be among the worst years, but less severe.

triage.headline_ja: 2024年のデング熱の世界的症例数が2023年から倍増し1,200万件に達する。研究により気候危機による異常降雨との関連が判明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急増、国際的拡大リスク）。南米の複数国にまたがる大規模流行で、気候変動との関連性が明確で、公開情報としても社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ペルー、ブラジル、エクアドルなど南米複数国での流行が報告されている。2024年の12百万症例は前年の6.5百万から倍増し、6,800人以上の死亡が報告されており、重症度が高い。サイクロンヤク及びエルニーニョ現象との因果関係が科学的に示唆されており、気候変動が媒介生物由来疾患の拡大に与える影響を示唆する貴重な事例である。WPROではなくAMRO地域に該当するが、グローバルな公衆衛生への影響が大きい。

article.articleHeadline: Como o vírus da gripe está afetando diferentes regiões do Brasil?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How is the influenza virus affecting different regions of Brazil?
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz InfoGripe reports rising Influenza A circulation across Brazil, with SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) cases increasing nationwide. Sharpest rise in Mato Grosso and most Northeast states, except Piauí; in the North, Amapá, Pará, and Rondônia show high activity; in the Southeast, Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo show increased circulation. Since 2026 began, SRAG-positive cases are led by Rhinovirus (41.9%), Influenza A (21.8%), SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) (14.7%), RSV (13.4%), and Influenza B (1.5%). Among deaths, COVID-19 accounts for 37.3%, Influenza A 28.6%, Rhinovirus 21.8%, RSV 4.5%, and Influenza B 2.5%; influenza A–related deaths rose in the last four weeks. Vaccination against influenza runs Mar 28–May 30 across Northeast, Midwest, South, and Southeast, with Dia D on Mar 28, 2026, as the main prevention of severe cases and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのインフルエンザウイルスがさまざまな地域にどのように影響を与えているか
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザA、COVID-19、RSV、インフルエンザB）が全国で循環拡大しており、SRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）症例が増加。死亡事例も報告されている。
triage.notes: 2026年初頭からSRAG陽性例が増加し、死亡例も報告されている。複合感染症（インフルエンザA、COVID-19、RSV等）の同時循環が特徴。政府による全国規模のワクチン接種キャンペーン（3月28日～5月30日）が実施予定。ブラジル全土の複数州で地理的に広範な影響が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Prevenção das arboviroses, dengue, zika e chikungunya começa dentro de casa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevention of arboviral diseases, dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya begins at home.
article.articleSummary: Prevention is the best defense against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, transmitted by Aedes aegypti. The article notes that the mosquito breeds in standing water, often inside homes. Simple actions can make a big difference in just 10 minutes: empty containers that collect water; keep water tanks tightly sealed; clean gutters; add sand to plant saucers; dispose of trash properly to eliminate breeding sites. If symptoms appear—fever, body aches, pain behind the eyes, or skin rashes—visit your nearest health post. Prevention starts at home, but benefits the whole community; set aside 10 minutes each week to inspect your yard and surroundings. Engage endemic agents who educate the public and identify potential mosquito sources. For questions or reports, contact Zoonoses: (75) 99168-8991.

triage.headline_ja: 家の中から始まるデング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱などのアルボウイルス病の予防
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防啓発コンテンツであり、新規感染症発生や流行拡大の報告ではない。ブラジルにおけるこれら疾患は既知の風土病であり、異常性や予想外性がない。
triage.notes: 記事内容は蚊媒介疾患（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）の予防啓発キャンペーンであり、新規アウトブレイクや異常な流行を報告するものではない。ブラジルにおいては既知の風土病である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Altas temperaturas favorecem mosquito da dengue; veja como prevenir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High temperatures favor the dengue mosquito; see how to prevent.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 March 2026, high temperatures raise dengue risk by accelerating Aedes aegypti breeding, increasing transmission when water accumulates. In São Paulo, the State Health Secretariat (SES-SP) emphasizes eliminating breeding sites inside homes and in surrounding areas to prevent dengue. Even tiny amounts of standing water can sustain the mosquito; a weekly home inspection is essential to reduce risk and prevent new cases. Prevention measures include: keeping trash sealed in plastic bags; removing leaves and debris that block gutters; filling plant pot saucers with sand to the rim; washing aquatic plant vases weekly with a brush, water and soap; keeping bottles and other containers that can collect water turned upside down; keeping water tanks well closed and discarding objects that accumulate water; and being extra vigilant after rainfall. Dengue symptoms can start suddenly and last five to seven days.

triage.headline_ja: 高温がデング熱蚊を促進；予防方法を確認
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の季節的リスク上昇を扱う予防啓発記事。具体的な症例数、死亡、国際的拡大の証拠がなく、IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし。ただしブラジル・サンパウロでの環境・ベクター要因の記述からWPRO基準1つ以上に該当する可能性があり、継続的な情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発を主目的としており、現在のアウトブレイク規模や症例数については記載なし。ブラジル・サンパウロ州における高温とAedes aegyptiの繁殖増加による季節的なリスク上昇を扱っており、ベクター媒介感染症として流行しやすい条件が存在することが確認される。州保健局による予防啓発が行われていることから政府関心が示唆される。具体的な患者数・死亡者・医療負荷については情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: Folha da Região: Araçatuba combate dengue e chikungunya neste sábado; CONFIRA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional Newspaper: Araçatuba fights dengue and chikungunya this Saturday; CHECK IT OUT.
article.articleSummary: Araçatuba, Brazil, expands anti-Aedes aegypti measures to curb dengue and chikungunya. The municipal health department intensifies door-to-door visits, insecticidal fogging, and ongoing surveillance of areas with higher notification rates. On Saturday, March 21, field agents will run a mutirão in the Casa Nova neighborhood from 7:30 to 13:30, focusing on eliminating breeding sites, applying larvicides, and providing residents with preventive guidance. To coordinate actions, the Secretaria Municipal de Saúde operates a Sala de Situação that integrates multiple sectors for planning and directing teams. Inspections extend to high-risk locations such as tire shops, cemeteries, schools, and industries. The municipality also supplies logistics, including trucks for collecting materials that can accumulate standing water, reinforcing efforts to reduce Aedes aegypti breeding grounds.

triage.headline_ja: 地域新聞：アラサツーバ市、土曜日にデング熱とチクングニア対策を実施；詳細確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのアラサツーバ市でデング熱とチクングニア熱の対策キャンペーンが報告されている。複数州での感染が示唆されているが、現在の記事は予防的介入活動の実施に焦点であり、アウトブレイク規模や死亡例などの重症度情報が不足している。
triage.notes: ブラジルではデング熱とチクングニア熱は風土病であり、季節的な対策は予想される。記事は感染者数、死亡例、入院患者数などの具体的な疫学データを含まない。Bahia州とSão Paulo州の複数地域での同時対策が示唆されるため、流行拡大の可能性について追加情報が必要。続報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Pelotas suspende aulas após surto de gastroenterite; norovírus é a principal suspeita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pelotas suspends classes after gastroenteritis outbreak; norovirus is the main suspect.
article.articleSummary: Norovirus is suspected in a gastroenteritis outbreak in Pelotas, southern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, with 77 cases among municipal school staff, teachers and students. Classes are suspended through Monday, March 23, to allow thorough disinfection of furniture, toys, and facilities; samples from ten affected schools are under analysis at the Central Public Health Laboratory (Lacen), with results expected in the coming days. The majority of cases involve children aged 0–5, though authorities warn the citywide tally may be higher. Norovirus is highly contagious and causes acute gastroenteritis. Common symptoms include low-grade fever, headache and muscle pains; transmission is predominantly fecal-oral via contaminated water or food, or contaminated surfaces. There is no specific antiviral treatment; care is supportive with hydration, rest, and strict hand hygiene. The city notes the suspension will not jeopardize the academic calendar, and activities will resume after sanitization.

triage.headline_ja: ペロタス市が胃腸炎の流行後に授業を中止、ノロウイルスが主な容疑者
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスによる胃腸炎の集団発生で77例、主に5歳以下の児童が罹患。都市レベルでの確定例が限定的で、現在検査中のため情報は部分的だが、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い可能性と継続的な曝露リスクを有す。
triage.notes: 学校閉鎖が実施されており、地域当局による対応が進行中。検査結果待ちのため、ノロウイルス確定までは推定症例の段階。死亡や重症化の報告はなく、支持的治療で対応可能な疾患だが、高い伝播性と小児集団環境での曝露継続リスクが懸念される。続報で確定患者数と検査結果を注視すること。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação do vírus da gripe está em alta em várias regiões do país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza virus circulation is high in several regions of the country.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 March 2026, the Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin reports high circulation of Influenza A across Brazil, driving SARI increases in Mato Grosso and the majority of Northeast states (except Piauí) and in the North (Amapá, Pará, Rondônia), with elevated activity in the Southeast (Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo). Since 2026 began, SARI positives are Rhinovirus 41.9%, Influenza A 21.8%, SARS-CoV-2 14.7%, RSV 13.4%, Influenza B 1.5%. Among deaths, SARS-CoV-2 37.3%, Influenza A 28.6%, Rhinovirus 21.8%, RSV 4.5%, Influenza B 2.5%; in the last four weeks, 30.8% for Influenza A and SARS-CoV-2 each, 27.5% Rhinovirus, 5.5% RSV, 2.7% Influenza B. National vaccination strategies aim to raise coverage and cut vaccine-preventable diseases. The influenza vaccination campaign runs March 28–May 30 in the Northeast, Central-West, South and Southeast, with Day D on March 28; RSV vaccine for pregnant women, and influenza A vaccination starts March 28 for priority groups.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザウイルスの流行は国内複数地域で高い水準にある
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザA型を中心とした複数の呼吸器疾患がブラジル全域で流行しており、SARI（重症急性呼吸器感染症）の増加が報告されている。死亡例も記録されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と予想外の広域流行が確認される。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健省（Fiocruz）が公式に高流行を報告しており、政府は3月28日からの全国予防接種キャンペーンを実施予定。複数州での同時多発的な流行であり、複合的な呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA型21.8%、RSV 13.4%、インフルエンザB型1.5%）が関与している点が特徴。死亡事例の記録も確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí lidera índice de dengue no Nordeste e já soma quase 1,9 mil casos suspeitos em 2026 - Portal O Dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí leads dengue incidence in the Northeast and already has nearly 1,900 suspected cases in 2026 - Portal O Dia.
article.articleSummary: Dengue leads the Northeast in 2026: Piauí reports 1,895 probable dengue cases, 852 confirmed, and the region's highest per-capita rate (56.0/100,000). Teresina accounts for most records (846 probable, 538 confirmed); São Raimundo Nonato 238 (66); Parnaíba 27 (20); Floriano 5 (3); Picos 2; no deaths. Nationally, Brazil exceeds 148,000 probable dengue cases; Northeast leaders by absolute numbers are Pernambuco (4,281), Maranhão (3,117) and Rio Grande do Norte (1,485). In Piauí, incidence is highest among 20–29-year-olds with a female predominance; since last year the state has over 11,000 suspected cases. Chikungunya totals reach 70 probable cases; Zika figures are not updated. Vaccination: February delivered 6,950 dengue vaccine doses to primary care, out of 13.9k planned, aiming for ~32,200 health workers. Instituto Butantan's vaccine is described as single-dose, with 74.7% efficacy against symptomatic dengue and 89% against severe disease. Teresina also offers a two-dose vaccine for children/adolescents 10–14, per Ministry guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州は北東部のデング熱発生率で首位、2026年にはすでに約1,900件の疑い例を報告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル北東部における複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ）の同時多発的流行。ピアウイ州で確認例852件を含む1,895件の疑い例、人口10万人あたり56.0の高い罹患率を記録しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を満たす可能性が高い。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内でも北東部における複数州での同時流行であり、地域的な流行として重要。ワクチン配布戦略が進行中だが、罹患率の上昇速度や他州との比較では深刻性の判断に注視が必要。配信日時が2026年3月と将来日付であるため、シミュレーション記事もしくはテスト用データの可能性があるが、評価基準上は内容に基づき処理。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana records major TB detection gap as 20,000 cases go untreated yearly - Ghanamma.com
article.articleSummary: Ghana's National Tuberculosis Programme warns of a detection gap, with about 20,000 TB cases undetected and untreated annually in Ghana. Ghana estimates 44,000 new TB cases each year, but capacity limits identify only 22,000–24,000, creating a shortfall that fuels community transmission of this airborne disease. Transmission occurs via droplets when coughing, sneezing, or talking. Pediatric detection is particularly low, expected 8–10% of all detected cases (about 2,000 children annually); in 2025 only 700 pediatric cases were identified. Authorities are intensifying screening in high-risk settings—prisons, slums, mining communities—and among people living with HIV and those with poorly controlled diabetes. TB remains curable: drug-susceptible TB requires six months of therapy; drug-resistant TB six to eight months. The programme promotes TB Preventive Therapy for close contacts and high-risk groups and advocates for unified investment in diagnostics, case-finding, and medication under the theme Yes, We Can End TB.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナが結核検出ギャップの拡大を記録、毎年20,000例が未治療のまま
triage.triage_reason: 結核とHIVの複合感染リスク、年間20,000例の未治療TB患者による継続的な地域感染、診断能力の構造的不足により、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度、長期曝露、流行易感性、管理可能性が複数該当するためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 結核の診断漏れ（年間20,000例）がHIV患者およびコミュニティレベルでの気道感染の継続的リスクになっている。小児TB検出率の著しい低さ（期待値8-10%に対し2025年は700例のみ）も懸念事項。診断能力拡充による外部支援の必要性が記事から明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação do vírus da gripe está em alta em várias regiões do país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Circulation of the influenza virus is on the rise in several regions of the country.
article.articleSummary: Rhinovirus is the leading cause of positive SARI cases in Brazil in 2026, followed by Influenza A and SARS-CoV-2. Regional patterns show a pronounced rise in Mato Grosso and most Northeast states (Piauí excluded); in the North, Amapá, Pará and Rondônia report growth; in the Southeast, Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo show rising indicators. Since 2026 began, the SARI epidemiology ranks Rhinovirus first, then Influenza A and SARS-CoV-2. Deaths overall are led by SARS-CoV-2 (37.3%), then Influenza A (28.6%); however, in the last four epidemiological weeks Influenza A and SARS-CoV-2 are tied at 30.8% each of positive deaths. Fiocruz researcher Tatiana Portella notes three national strategies for 2026 to boost vaccination coverage and reduce hospitalizations from preventable diseases. The influenza vaccination campaign for priority groups runs March 28–May 30, with the national Day D mobilization on March 28. RSV vaccination is available for pregnant women to protect newborns.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザウイルスの流通が同国の複数地域で増加している
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全域（7州）の複数地域でインフルエンザA、RSV感染が増加傾向を示しており、死亡率の上昇（インフルエンザAが過去4週間で30.8%）が報告されている。IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」の複数項目が合致するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル保健当局（Fiocruz）による2026年国家戦略が既に展開中（ワクチン接種キャンペーン3月28日開始）。複数病原体（インフルエンザA、RSV、SARS-CoV-2）の同時流行パターンを示唆。北東部、北部、南東部の広範な地域で増加傾向が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt xuất huyết Dengue và những dự định dở dang bên giường bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever and unfinished plans by the bedside.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Ho Chi Minh City's adults shows rapid deterioration after defervescence, with dengue shock syndrome, liver and kidney injury, and multi-organ failure risk. At Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases, a 34-year-old man presented with high fever and, after initial improvement, sudden hypotension requiring emergency admission. The case illustrates dengue's potential to worsen quickly during the defervescence phase, due to plasma leakage, hemoconcentration, and thrombocytopenia. Nationally, severe dengue proportions have risen from about 15% to 17–19% in recent years, with frequent shock and advanced liver injury. Dengue cases occur year-round; urbanization and climate change boost Aedes aegypti breeding, including inside homes in water containers and vases. Prevention emphasizes removing breeding sites, covering water containers, bed nets, vector control, and vaccination. Warn signs: persistent high fever, fatigue, myalgia, abdominal pain, vomiting, or bleeding require urgent medical care. The article is government-funded with Takeda Việt Nam collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱と病床での未完のプラン
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ホーチミン市でのデング熱流行に関する報告であり、重症化率の上昇（15%→17-19%）、多臓器不全リスク、年間を通じた患者発生が確認されている。IHR基準では異常性と国内公衆衛生影響が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度、長期曝露、流行リスク、管理可能性の複数基準が該当する。
triage.notes: SFTS Virusも疾患カテゴリに含まれているが、記事サマリーではデング熱が主題。重症デング熱の割合が数年間で15%から17-19%に上昇している点、並びに年間を通じた患者発生と都市化・気候変動による蚊の繁殖増加が継続的な脅威を示唆している。政府資金による記事掲載とTakeda Vietnam協力から、ベトナム保健当局の関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil tem alta circulação do vírus da gripe em várias regiões
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil sees high circulation of the influenza virus in several regions.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 March 2026, Fiocruz InfoGripe reports widespread Influenza A circulation across Brazil, with SARI activity rising in Mato Grosso and most of the Northeast (except Piauí), plus the North (Amapá, Pará, Rondônia) and the Southeast (Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo). Since the start of 2026, SARI positives are Rhinovirus 41.9%, Influenza A 21.8%, SARS-CoV-2 14.7%, RSV 13.4%, Influenza B 1.5%. Deaths: SARS-CoV-2 37.3%, Influenza A 28.6%, Rhinovirus 21.8%, RSV 4.5%, Influenza B 2.5%. In the last four epidemiological weeks, deaths were 30.8% Influenza A, 30.8% SARS-CoV-2, 27.5% Rhinovirus, 5.5% RSV, 2.7% Influenza B. The Health Ministry defines three national vaccination strategies for 2026 to widen coverage. The influenza vaccination campaign runs 28 March–30 May in the Northeast, Midwest, South and Southeast; RSV vaccine for pregnant women is available, and influenza vaccination for priority groups starts 28 March.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで複数地域におけるインフルエンザウイルスの高い循環
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザAが全国的に循環し、複数州でSARI活動の上昇が報告されている。死亡例も報告されており、公衆衛生への影響が深刻であると認められ、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: ブラジル全域での複数ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV、インフルエンザB）の同時循環が報告されている。Fiocruz InfoGripeによる監視データが確実であり、保健省による積極的なワクチン接種キャンペーンが既に実施されている。国内で対応可能と判断されるためWPRO基準では管理可能性「No」とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ học sinh ở Phú Quốc tử vong do viêm não mô cầu: An Giang khuyến cáo hạn chế tụ tập đông người
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a student in Phu Quoc due to meningococcal meningitis: An Giang advises limiting large gatherings.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 March 2026, An Giang Province Health Department reports that an 11-year-old student from Phú Quốc (special economic zone) died on 16 March from meningococcal meningitis (Group B). An Giang CDC and Phú Quốc Medical Center extended contact tracing, identifying about 40 people living in the patient’s dormitory in Duong Dong, and 36 students plus a teacher at Duong Dong 4 School as close contacts. A classmate with meningococcal meningitis–like symptoms is being treated at Ho Chi Minh City’s Hospital for Tropical Diseases; condition is stable. Meningococcal meningitis spreads via respiratory droplets and can cause outbreaks in crowded settings, with 8–10% case fatality and 10–20% risk of neurological sequelae. Public health measures include limiting gatherings, avoiding contact with patients or suspects, strict hygiene, and use of nasal/throat antiseptics; close contacts should receive antibiotic prophylaxis and vaccination. The department seeks higher-level support to bolster care in Phú Quốc.

triage.headline_ja: フーコック島の学生が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎で死亡：アンザン省が大人数集会の制限を勧告
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による死亡例、複数地域での接触者特定、致命率8-10%と高い重症度、集団発生リスクがある。IHR基準2項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 死亡例は11歳学生、グループBの髄膜炎菌、接触者は寮生約40名と学校関係者37名。フーコック島は特別経済区で人口移動が多く、ホーチミン市での類似症例も報告。当局が高次支援を求めており管理体制に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Campak Mengintai di Indonesia, Kenali Gejala, Risiko Komplikasi, dan Cara Pencegahannya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles Lurking in Indonesia: Recognize the Symptoms, Risk of Complications, and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreaks surged in Indonesia during 2025–early 2026: 63,769 suspected cases in 2025 with 11,094 laboratory-confirmed and 69 deaths; by week 7 of 2026, 8,224 suspected, 572 confirmed, and 4 deaths. Twenty-one suspected outbreaks occurred across 17 districts/cities in 11 provinces. Measles is highly contagious, spread by droplets and contaminated surfaces; incubation 10–12 days. Early symptoms resemble flu—high fever, cough, runny nose, red, tearing eyes—followed by Koplik spots and a rash that starts on the face and behind the ears, then spreads and darkens before fading. Complications include otitis media, severe diarrhea with dehydration, pneumonia, and encephalitis, especially in unvaccinated or immunocompromised children. No specific antiviral exists; care is supportive, with vitamin A per age to reduce mortality. Prevention emphasizes hygiene, cough etiquette, isolation, and vaccination per IDAI: MR vaccine at 9 months, boosters at 15–18 months and 5–7 years.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアに潜むはしか：症状、合併症リスク、予防方法を知る
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで2025～2026年初期に大規模はしか流行が発生（確定症例11,094件、死亡69件）。高い感染力、多地域への拡大（11州17地区）、死亡例と重症合併症の報告により、IHR基準2つ以上該当し、国際的拡大リスクも存在するためシグナルとして適格。
triage.notes: はしかは高い感染力（飛沫感染）、長い潜伏期間（10～12日）を持ち、未接種・免疫不全児に重症化リスク。2025年の死亡率は0.6%程度だが、複数州での同時流行と継続的な新規患者発生（2026年第7週も症例報告）が継続的な曝露と長期的な公衆衛生脅威を示唆。ワクチン接種率データは不明だが、地域的な感染拡大の管理可能性には疑問の余地あり。

article.articleHeadline: Fiocruz alerta para alta na circulação do vírus da gripe no Brasil - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fiocruz warns of increased circulation of the influenza virus in Brazil - News Rondônia
article.articleSummary: Fiocruz's InfoGripe bulletin reports rising Influenza A circulation in Brazil, with SRAG hospitalizations increasing in the North, Northeast, and Central-West, notably Mato Grosso, Pará, and Rondônia; Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo show rising trends in the Southeast. Since 2026, Rhinovirus leads SRAG positives (41.9%), followed by Influenza A (21.8%) and COVID-19 (14.7%). Mortality from COVID-19 and Influenza A accounts for about 30.8% each of viral deaths in the last four weeks. Experts warn that influenza and coronavirus pose major risks to vulnerable groups despite Rhinovirus driving more hospitalizations. The Health Ministry will expand vaccination, with a national influenza campaign from March 28 to May 30 targeting the elderly, pregnant women, and health professionals in the Northeast, Central-West, South, and Southeast. The 2026 calendar also includes RSV vaccine for pregnant women. Dia D mobilization is scheduled for the upcoming Saturday to accelerate protection before cooler weather, with Fiocruz monitoring guiding hospital capacity.

triage.headline_ja: Fiocruz、ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザウイルス流通の増加を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全域での複数呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザA、COVID-19、RSV）の同時流行兆候が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、複数州への広がり）を満たす。国家的な予防接種キャンペーン実施予定が公表されている。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA、COVID-19、RSV、ライノウイルス）が同時流行中。SRAG（重症急性呼吸器感染症）入院が北部、北東部、中西部で増加。ブラジル保健省が全国予防接種キャンペーンを3月28日～5月30日に実施予定。死亡率分析によりCOVID-19とインフルエンザAが重篤。情報日付は2026年3月21日（将来日付のため検証推奨）。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh nhi ở Phú Quốc tử vong do viêm não mô cầu: F1 uống kháng sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A child in Phu Quoc dies of meningococcal meningitis: F1 should take antibiotics.
article.articleSummary: On 21 March 2026, a child in Phú Quốc, Kiên Giang, died of meningococcal meningitis. Public health authorities traced close contacts (F1) and started antibiotic prophylaxis. By 20 March, 100% of F1 contacts had received antibiotics, including 735 of 1,460 students at Duong Dong 4 Primary School where patient Y studied. By the afternoon of 21 March, remaining students and teachers at the school were receiving prophylaxis in a group administration. A second suspected meningococcal meningitis case, a student who shared the same class and row, has been transferred to Ho Chi Minh City’s Hospital for Tropical Diseases for evaluation and is reported as stable. The death has spurred a surge in meningococcal vaccination demand in Phú Quốc, with parents rushing to vaccination sites over the past four days. Local authorities ordered intensified monitoring and supervision of vaccination activities.

triage.headline_ja: Phú Quốc島の子どもが髄膜炭疽菌性髄膜炎で死亡：濃厚接触者が抗生物質を服用
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎による死亡例が確認され、濃厚接触者が1,460人以上の学校で拡大している。国内での流行可能性が高く、クラスター管理と感染拡大防止措置が進行中である。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は致死的疾患であり、今回の死亡事例と疑い例の発生、学校内での濃厚接触者が1,460人超という規模から、国内での流行拡大のリスクが高い。濃厚接触者への抗生物質投与による予防対策は実施されているが、クラスター形成の可能性がある。ワクチン需要の急増も公衆衛生上の関心の高さを示唆している。IHR基準を2つ以上満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準すべてに該当するため、フルリスク評価（RRA）への進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Minsa emite alerta sanitaria por riesgo de leptospirosis tras lluvias intensas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health issues a health alert due to the risk of leptospirosis after heavy rains.
article.articleSummary: Peru's Ministry of Health issued Epidemiological Alert AE-CDC-N°004-2026 amid rising leptospirosis risk linked to heavy rains. The intervention targets districts across emergency-declared regions: Amazonas, Áncash, Apurímac, Arequipa, Ayacucho, Cajamarca, Cusco, Huancavelica, Huánuco, Ica, Junín, La Libertad, Lambayeque, Lima, Loreto, Madre de Dios, Moquegua, Pasco, Piura, Puno, San Martín, Tacna, Tumbes, and Ucayali. Actions include enhanced epidemiological surveillance, immediate case notification, and sample processing within 24 hours. Molecular diagnosis will be implemented via PCR at the national reference laboratory. Leptospirosis is caused by Leptospira bacteria and transmitted through water or food contaminated with urine from infected animals. Symptoms: high fever, headache, muscle pain, abdominal pain, red eyes, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea. Authorities advise avoiding contact with stagnant water, maintaining hygiene, and intensifying cleaning to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 鼠疫防止省がレプトスピラ症のリスクについて保健警報を発令 - 強い降雨の後
triage.triage_reason: ペルー全土（24地域以上）でレプトスピラ症の公式警報が発令され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と多地域での異常な流行兆候が認められる。IHR基準3項目以上該当でシグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: ペルー保健省（MINSA）による公式警報AE-CDC-N°004-2026の発令。強い降雨による環境的リスク要因が明確。24地域以上の広域にわたる関与と、PCR検査を含む強化された疫学的監視体制の構築が記載されている。レプトスピラ症はげっ歯類由来の細菌感染症で、水系媒介性感染症として公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。ブラジルも関連地域として識別されているが、国際的拡大状況は記事内では不明。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe e resfriado avançam rápido antes do período de alta, alerta Friocruz - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu and the common cold spread quickly before the peak period, Friocruz warns - Brasília Journal.
article.articleSummary: As of March 21, 2026, Brazil's Infogripe (Fiocruz) warns that influenza A and rhinovirus are spreading rapidly before the autumn-winter peak. In epidemiological week 10 (Mar 8–14), influenza A drove SRAG (severe acute respiratory syndrome) increases in Mato Grosso and across most Northeast states (except Piauí), plus Amapá, Pará, Rondônia, and in Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo in the Southeast. By March 20, 2026, 20,300 SRAG cases had been notified, with 7,523 laboratory-confirmed for a virus. Among positives, rhinovirus accounted for 41.9%, influenza A for 21.8%, and COVID-19 for 14.7%. Ministry of Health data through Mar 14 show 865 SRAG deaths, 345 with lab confirmation for a respiratory virus; COVID-19 comprised 37% of deaths, influenza A 28%.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザと風邪が秋冬シーズン前に急速に拡大、Friocruzが警告 - ブラジリア・ジャーナル
triage.triage_reason: 複数地域でのインフルエンザA・COVID-19の同時流行、高い死亡率（SRAG死者865名、確認376名）、および秋冬ピークシーズン前の急速な増加が報告されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内の複数州（Pará、Amapá、Piauí、Rio de Janeiro、Rondônia、Espírito Santo等）にわたる同時多発的なSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の増加。確認死者の37%がCOVID-19、28%がインフルエンザAで占められている。秋冬シーズン前のプリシーズン流行は南半球としても懸念される。医療当局（Fiocruz、保健省）からの公式警告により政府関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Thêm 1 học sinh ở Phú Quốc bị nhiễm viêm não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another student in Phú Quốc contracted meningococcal meningitis.
article.articleSummary: On 21 March 2026, An Giang Province Health Department reported a meningococcal meningitis case in Phú Quốc, Kiên Giang. An 11-year-old girl, T.H.N.Y., from khu phố 10, Phú Quốc area, was admitted 16 March at 10:00 with septic shock and a widespread rash; vaccination history is unknown. Despite treatment per Ministry of Health protocol, she died at 15:00 the same day. The department directed the provincial CDC to assist Phú Quốc’s Medical Center with outbreak investigation, contact tracing, and prophylaxis for close contacts, and to intensify prevention. Another classmate of the patient with meningococcal symptoms is being treated at Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases; the classmate’s condition is stable, prognosis good. Other students and teachers who had contact are monitored; no suspected cases in family or residence. Meningococcal meningitis is a Group B bacterium, transmitted by respiratory droplets, with 8–15% mortality, 10–20% neurological sequelae, and 5–25% carriage.

triage.headline_ja: フーコック島のもう1人の学生が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に感染
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の致死例（11歳女児）とクラスター発生（複数の患者）が報告された。高い致死率（8-15%）と神経学的後遺症のリスクを持つ重篤疾患であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で複数該当。IHR基準では公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性が明確。
triage.notes: 複数地域（キエンザン省フーコック島、ホーチミン市）での症例報告。初発症例は致死（入院同日死亡）。同じ学校の別の学生が症状を呈し治療中。当局は疫学調査・接触者追跡・予防措置を実施済み。髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎は集団発生のリスク高く、迅速な対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 2 bệnh nhân nghi ngộ độc thực phẩm do độc tố Botulinum đã được xuất viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two patients suspected of botulinum toxin–related food poisoning have been discharged.
article.articleSummary: Two children, H.Q.B (11) and H.Q.N (7), from Phuoc Năng commune, Da Nang City (Phuoc Son district, formerly Quang Nam province), were discharged on 21 March 2026 after more than 12 days of intensive care for suspected botulinum toxin–related food poisoning. They arrived in coma with weakness and respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation, treated with Botulism Antitoxin and plasmapheresis. Botulinum toxin is produced by Clostridium botulinum and can cause paralysis and life-threatening respiratory failure. The Botulism Antitoxin, delivered to Da Nang around 11 March 2026 via WHO coordination from Switzerland, enabled timely treatment. WHO and local health authorities supported rapid access to the antidote and optimal clinical management. By discharge, both children were reported fully healthy. This case underscores the importance of rapid antitoxin availability and international cooperation in managing botulism risks in Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: ボツリヌス毒素関連食中毒が疑われた2人の患者が退院
triage.triage_reason: ボツリヌス毒素による重症食中毒事例で、呼吸不全を伴う重篤な症状（人工呼吸器装着）、国際的な抗毒素供給の必要性、複数国間の協力が関与しており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: ベトナムの2人の小児患者が重症ボツリヌス毒素食中毒（呼吸不全、人工呼吸器装着）で治療され退院。スイスからWHO経由で国際的に抗毒素が供給された。単一食事イベント由来と考えられ、散発例である可能性が高いが、重症度、治療の国際協力、公衆衛生警告価値により検出・報告する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Após enchentes em Juiz de Fora, disparam casos suspeitos de doenças infecciosas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After floods in Juiz de Fora, suspected cases of infectious diseases spike.
article.articleSummary: After floods that killed 73 people in Juiz de Fora, suspected infectious diseases rise. Juiz de Fora, where 65 people died, faces an outbreak of hepatitis A; by Mar 19, 2026 there were 248 hepatitis A cases in the city, up 6,100% from 2025 (4). Hospitalizations are increasing; transmission linked to disrupted water, contaminated wells, displacement, and crowded conditions. Vaccination campaigns target exposed groups; Minas Gov allocated 10,000 hepatitis A doses to Juiz de Fora and 5,000 to Ubá, plus 17,500 bottles of sodium hypochlorite for water/food safety. The Ministry provided kits and support for up to 13,500 people. In Ubá, eight flood deaths are reported and leptospirosis is a concern, with 118 suspected cases (41 under investigation, 57 awaiting testing, 19 dismissed) and one death. Leptospirosis symptoms resemble dengue; prophylaxis for high-exposure cases; routine use is not recommended; physicians assess exposure risk. Authorities stress hygiene and potable water monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ジュイス・デ・フォーラの洪水後、感染症疑い症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。洪水後の複数感染症（A型肝炎、レプトスピラ症、デング熱）同時発生で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ミナスジェライス州での大規模洪水（死者73名）に伴い、複数の水系感染症が同時に発生。A型肝炎248例（前年同期比6,100%増）、レプトスピラ症118疑い例（死亡1名）が報告されている。給水システム破壊、井戸汚染、過密避難所という持続的な曝露リスクが存在。州政府・厚生省による迅速な対応が実施されているが、感染者数の急増と複数疾患の同時流行により国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Vanderlei Luxemburgo apresenta melhora após internação para tratar infecção pulmonar  - O Jornal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vanderlei Luxemburgo shows improvement after hospitalization to treat a lung infection - The Journal
article.articleSummary: Vanderlei Luxemburgo, a football coach and businessman from Palmas, the capital of Tocantins, Brazil, was hospitalized in the ICU with a lung infection. As of 2026-03-21, his condition is stable, with normal blood pressure and respiration. He was admitted after feeling unwell in the early hours of March 20. He remains in intensive care to complete the antibiotic course. Discharge is expected on Sunday, March 22. All weekend engagements have been canceled, and his schedule will resume next week with medical precautions to be observed for the next 15 days. He resides in Palmas and maintains business interests in Tocantins. The report notes ongoing antibiotic therapy and that the medical team plans to monitor him during the remaining treatment period.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァンダーレイ・ルクセンブルゴが肺感染症の治療のための入院後に改善を示す
triage.triage_reason: 単一の既知患者（著名人）の肺感染症であり、原因病原体が不明で一般的な感染症クラスターではない。状態は安定しており、国際的拡大のリスクやパンデミック的懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事象は著名なサッカーコーチ個人の医療ニュースであり、感染症危機管理の対象外。疾患が「Unknown Illness」として分類されているが、記事内容は肺感染症（抗生物質で治療中）と明記されており、単発症例である。社会的関心は高い可能性があるが、公衆衛生的脅威や感染症流行の兆候には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe e resfriado avançam rápido antes do período de alta, alerta Friocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu and cold spread rapidly ahead of the peak season, Fiocruz warns.
article.articleSummary: As of March 20, 2026, Brazil faces rapid spread of influenza A and rhinovirus ahead of the autumn-winter peak, per Fiocruz Infogripe which monitors severe acute respiratory illness (SARI) nationwide. Data from epidemiological week 10 (March 8–14) show influenza A driving SARI increases in Mato Grosso and most Northeastern states (except Piauí), plus Amapá, Pará, Rondônia, and in Rio de Janeiro and Espírito Santo. By March 20, about 20,300 SARI cases had been notified, with 7,523 having lab-confirmed viral results. Among positives: rhinovirus 41.9%, influenza A 21.8%, and COVID-19 14.7%. The Ministry of Health reports 865 SARI deaths through March 14, of which 345 were lab-confirmed for respiratory viruses; COVID-19 accounted for 37% of these deaths, followed by influenza A at 28%.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザと風邪が流行期前に急速に拡大、Fiocruzが警告
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19とインフルエンザAの同時流行がブラジル全域で確認され、SARI関連の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」と「異常または予想外」に該当し、地域的な管理能力評価が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルにおけるCOVID-19とインフルエンザAの複数地域同時流行。2026年3月時点で約20,300件のSARI通知、865件の死亡が報告されている。ただし記事は2026年の日付を持つ架空データと考えられる可能性がある。公式なFiocruzデータとの照合が推奨される。
