article.articleHeadline: Nova cepa do vírus da mpox recombinante preocupa a OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New recombinant mpox virus strain concerns the WHO.
article.articleSummary: New recombinant mpox (monkeypox) virus strain raises WHO concern. Detected February 2026, the novel recombinant blends genetic elements from mpox clade Ib (more severe, higher mortality, especially in children/immunocompromised) and clade IIb (driving the 2022 global outbreak). WHO suggests broader circulation than reported; two confirmed cases with travel histories—UK and India—signal transmission across at least four countries in three WHO regions. Conventional PCR failed to identify the recombinant; whole-genome sequencing confirmed the hybrid. Therapeutically, tecovirimat’s utility is questioned after the STOMP trial (344 immunocompetent adults with clade 2 mpox) showed no improvement in lesion resolution (83% vs 84%), pain reduction (0.1/10), or viral clearance; PALM007 in DRC with clade 1 yielded similar results, highlighting gaps for immunocompromised, pregnant, and pediatric patients. In Brazil, clade Ib detected in São Paulo (March 2025). Prevention centers on vaccination with Jynneos (MVA-BN) via SUS for priority groups, now emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 新型組換えmpoxウイルス株がWHOの懸念を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: 新型の組換えMpoxウイルス株（Clade Ib と Clade IIb の遺伝的要素を結合）が2026年2月に検出され、英国・インド・ブラジルを含む少なくとも3つのWHO地域の4カ国に確認された。Clade Ibは重症度・致死率が高く（特に小児・免疫不全者）、従来のPCRでは同定不可、ゲノム配列決定により確認。WHO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 2026年3月時点での記事であり、新型組換えMpoxの出現と国際的拡大は重要なシグナル。Tecovirimatの有効性に疑問（STOMP試験で有意な改善なし）、免疫不全者・妊婦・小児患者への治療ギャップあり。ブラジルではClade Ibが2025年3月にSão Pauloで検出済み。従来の診断法では検出困難な点も懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Phú Quốc: Thêm 1 bệnh nhi nhiễm viêm não mô cầu là bạn học của trường hợp tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phú Quốc: Another pediatric patient with meningococcal meningitis is the classmate of the fatal case.
article.articleSummary: On 21 March 2026, An Giang Department of Health issued a press release about a meningococcal meningitis case in Phu Quoc Special Zone. An 11-year-old girl from Ward 10 presented on 16 March at Phu Quoc Medical Center with septic shock and a widespread rash; vaccination history is unclear. Laboratory tests confirmed meningococcal meningitis. Due to rapid deterioration, she died at 15:00 the same day after the family requested discharge. The department, with the Phu Quoc Center for Disease Control, initiated rapid contact tracing and prophylaxis for close contacts and intensified local prevention. A classmate with symptoms is treated at Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases; health status is stable. Other students and teachers are under health monitoring; about 70 close contacts are monitored. Meningococcal disease (Group B) is respiratory-transmitted and can cause meningitis with 8-15% mortality and 10-20% neuro sequelae.

triage.headline_ja: フーコック：致死例の同級生である小児患者が髄膜炎菌髄膜炎に追加で感染
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌髄膜炎による死亡例と追加患者の報告、学校での集団曝露の可能性、および急速な患者増加の兆候がIHR基準（深刻な影響、異常性）とWPRO基準（高い重症度、流行可能性、集団曝露）の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌B群による死亡例が報告され、同じ学校環境で追加患者が確認された。約70名の密接接触者が監視対象となっており、集団曝露のリスクが高い。迅速な接触者追跡と予防措置が実施されている。死亡率8-15％の高毒性病原体であり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh do phế cầu khuẩn có nguy cơ gia tăng ở trẻ nhỏ và người cao tuổi năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pneumococcal disease is projected to rise among young children and the elderly in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Pneumococcal disease and RSV infections are forecast to rise in early 2026 in Vietnam, especially among children and the elderly, per the Ministry of Health's 2026 Infectious Disease Prevention Plan. The Ho Chi Minh City Respiratory Society's 2026 Annual Conference, co-organized with Pfizer Vietnam and attracting about 800 clinicians, highlighted advances in diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of pneumonia, pediatric respiratory disease, COPD, lung cancer, interstitial lung disease, imaging, AI, and ICU care. Globally, WHO reports 1.6 million pneumococcal-disease deaths annually, including 0.7–1 million in children under 5; pneumococcal pneumonia remains a leading cause of community-acquired pneumonia. In Vietnam, 87.7% of the elderly have at least one chronic condition. RSV affects the elderly and infants; CDC 2024–2025 data show 3.6–6.5 million outpatient visits, 190k–350k hospitalizations, 10k–23k deaths; Vietnam’s RSV infections are estimated at 4.5 million (2020–2025). Emphasis on early risk assessment and integrated prevention, with social mobilization per policy 282/NQ-CP.

triage.headline_ja: 肺炎球菌感染症は2026年に幼児と高齢者で増加が予測されている
triage.triage_reason: RSVと肺炎球菌感染症の増加予測がベトナムで報告されており、複数のWPRO基準に該当する可能性があるが、これは予測情報であり現在の発生状況の詳細が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 本イベントは2026年の予測情報に基づいており、現在の発生件数・死亡者数などの具体的データが不足している。ベトナム保健省が2026年感染症予防計画で言及しており、政府レベルの関心は高い。RSVと肺炎球菌の両方が対象で、幼児と高齢者が高リスク層とされている。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados decreta estado de emergência em meio à epidemia de chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados declares a state of emergency amid the Chikungunya epidemic.
article.articleSummary: March 21, 2026: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, declared a state of emergency amid a Chikungunya epidemic. New Municipal Health Secretary Marcelo Luiz Brandão Vilela described persistent pressures from medicine shortages, insufficient beds, and delays in specialized care, intensified by public bidding challenges. He outlined steps to stabilize supply for over 250 items, aided by 11 technicians in the bidding office, aiming for an 85% stock readiness. Plans include expanding beds at the University Hospital and Santa Casa, with the Regional Hospital no longer under state contractual control. The University Hospital is managed by Ebserh, requiring federal approval in Brasília; contracting steps have been sent to Brasília and await sign-off. The strategy has been presented to the Mato Grosso do Sul Public Prosecutor's Office as part of public accountability.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥアラドス、チクングニア流行の中で緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でのチクングニア流行拡大、地方自治体による緊急事態宣言、医療システムの逼迫が報告されており、IHR基準3項目以上、WPRO基準複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: ブラジルのドゥアラドス市がチクングニア流行を理由に緊急事態を宣言。医薬品不足、病床不足、専門医療の遅延といった医療システムの機能不全が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかである。記事配信日時が2026年3月となっており、将来日付のため検証が必要な可能性があるが、情報内容から複数の州（Federal District、São Paulo、Mato Grosso do Sul）での流行拡大が示唆される。WPRO基準5項目全てに該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Crato realiza campanha de vacinação contra Influenza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crato conducts an influenza vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Crato, Brazil launches an influenza vaccination campaign on the morning of 21 March 2026, led by the Municipal Health Secretariat. The drive targets priority groups defined by the Ministry of Health, including the elderly, children aged 6 months to under 6 years, pregnant women, postpartum women (puérperas), and other groups in the national vaccination strategy. Vaccinations run until 1:00 PM at three sites: Centro de Especialidades (Center of Specialties), UBS Ailton Esmeraldo (Centro), and UBS da Cohab in the Seminário neighborhood. The Health Secretariat emphasizes that influenza vaccination reduces complications, hospitalizations, and deaths from influenza, especially among vulnerable populations, and asks attendees to bring identification and their SUS card.

triage.headline_ja: Cratorインフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザの定期的なワクチン接種キャンペーン報道であり、新規の感染症シグナルではない。予定された公衆衛生対策の実施通知のため、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準とも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規の感染症イベント（流行、アウトブレイク、原因不明疾患）ではなく、ブラジル・クラト市における定期的なインフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンの実施通知である。ワクチン推進活動は公衆衛生の標準的取り組みであり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 'Gánh nặng kép' khi người già mắc bệnh mạn tính nhiễm khuẩn hô hấp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The double burden of chronic bacterial respiratory infection in the elderly.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, 21 March 2026 — The annual respiratory conference warns of a 'double burden' of chronic bacterial respiratory infection among the elderly. In Vietnam, 87.7% of seniors have at least one chronic disease, heightening vulnerability to Streptococcus pneumoniae–related pneumonia, now the leading cause of community-acquired pneumonia, and to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The Ministry of Health 2026 plan flags these pathogens as high-risk early in the year. Globally, pneumococcal disease causes about 1.6 million deaths annually. RSV imposes substantial burden: US CDC data (Oct 2024–May 2025) estimate 190,000–350,000 RSV hospitalizations and 10,000–23,000 deaths, with the oldest patients most affected; Vietnam’s RSV acute respiratory infections are projected near 4.5 million (2020–2025). Chronic conditions (cardiovascular disease, COPD, diabetes, immunodeficiency) raise risk of severe infection. Experts call for holistic, risk-based management and better translation of new evidence into practice, with Pfizer Vietnam support.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者における慢性細菌性呼吸器感染症の二重負担
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムのホーチミン市で高齢者における肺炎球菌とRSVの二重感染リスクについての警告記事。既知の感染症に関する疾患負担の警告であり、新規発生事例の報告ではないため、現段階では経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は新規発生事例の報告ではなく、既知の呼吸器感染症（肺炎球菌とRSV）に関する公開討論会・専門家警告の報道。ベトナム保健省が2026年の重点対象として位置付けており、政府レベルの関心は存在。ただしIHR基準では国際的拡大のリスクや具体的なアウトブレイクの報告がないため、IHR該当数は1。WPROスクリーニング基準では流行性・重症度・長期曝露でYesだが、新規シグナルというより既知リスクの強調であるため、WATCH判定が妥当。続報（具体的患者数増加、クラスター報告など）を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Gorakhpur News: गर्मी बढ्ते ही फंगल इंफेक्शन में तेजी से बढ़ोत्तरी
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gorakhpur News: As temperatures rise, fungal infections surge rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Gorakhpur, India — rising temperatures coincide with a surge in fungal skin infections. Department heads say climate isn’t the only cause; wrong dosing, incomplete treatment, and self-medication without a doctor’s advice keep infections stubborn and spreading. In the Dermatology OPD this month, fungal infections ranged from 19% to 41% of patients, with 19% on March 11 and 41% on March 13. Market creams used without medical guidance worsen outcomes, giving short-term relief but fostering more complex infections. Experts urge not to trivialize skin diseases: timely, correct treatment and patience are essential. The main problem is incomplete, irregular therapy; patients stop medicines early, so the infection persists. Incorrect dosing and self-medication may reduce drug effectiveness and prolong illness; emphasis is on proper dose, duration, and regular follow-ups.

triage.headline_ja: ゴラクプル発ニュース：気温上昇に伴い真菌感染症が急速に増加
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessの分類で具体的な病原体が特定されておらず、真菌皮膚感染症という限定的な医学的脅威であるため、IHR基準該当数は不明。スクリーニング基準でいくつか懸念項目がある一方で、情報不足が多く経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域はインド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ゴラクプル。疾患は真菌皮膚感染症で、気温上昇に伴う季節的増加と報告されている。3月11日～13日のデータで患者全体に占める割合が19～41%と急速な増加を示している点が「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」の観点で懸念される。ただし死亡報告や重症例の記載がなく、治療管理の問題が主因とされており、一般的な皮膚科領域の問題に留まる可能性が高い。病原体特定や国家衛生当局の対応状況に関する情報が不足しているため、継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Thêm một ca nghi mắc não mô cầu ở Phú Quốc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another suspected case of meningococcal meningitis in Phú Quốc.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 March 2026, Phú Quốc, Kiên Giang Province, Vietnam reported a suspected meningococcal meningitis case after the death of an 11-year-old classmate five days earlier. The new suspected case is among 36 students in the same class as the fatal patient, caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B. The patient is being treated at Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases and is in stable condition. Contact tracing identified 45 exposed individuals, including family members and 40 dormitory residents; close contacts received prophylactic antibiotics or vaccination. No additional suspected cases have been detected. Kiên Giang authorities are increasing epidemiological surveillance, detection capacity, and risk communication, seeking extra staff for island healthcare. Meningococcal meningitis can progress rapidly, with up to 50% mortality within 24–48 hours and about 20% of survivors with long-term sequelae; Neisseria meningitidis serogroups A, B, C, W, Y. In 2025 nationwide: 95 cases, 3 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: フー・クック島でコミュニティ獲得髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の新たな疑い例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（血清型B）による小児死亡事例が発生し、同じ環境内で新たな疑い例が確認されました。IHR基準で異常性・国際的懸念・公衆衛生影響が認められ、多くのスクリーニング基準を満たしています。フルRRA進行が必要です。
triage.notes: 血清型Bのクラスター検出（小児死亡＋同クラス36人中の疑い例）、45人の接触者追跡実施、島嶼部での医療体制強化要求、2025年全国で95例3死亡の背景。ベトナムはWPRO地域の重要な懸念事項。対面接触と寮環境での感染リスク継続。

article.articleHeadline: Piauí registra quase 1,9 mil casos de dengue e lidera índice no Nordeste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Piauí reports nearly 1,900 dengue cases and leads the incidence rate in the Northeast.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Piauí, Brazil, 2026: 1,895 probable dengue cases with 852 confirmed by 21 March. The state leads the Northeast with 56.0 suspected cases per 100,000. Teresina has 846 probable cases (538 confirmed); São Raimundo Nonato 238 (66 confirmed); Parnaíba 27 (20 confirmed). Floriano 5 (3 confirmed) and Picos 2 suspected. No dengue deaths reported. In the Northeast, Piauí ranks fourth in absolute numbers; Brazil totals exceed 148,000 probable dengue cases this year. Highest incidence occurs among 20–29-year-olds, with female predominance. Since last year, the state has over 11,000 suspected cases. Other arboviruses: 70 probable chikungunya cases; no Zika updates. Vaccination: February delivery of Butantan dengue vaccine—6,950 doses delivered of 13.9k planned, aiming to immunize about 32,200 primary care professionals. The vaccine is single-dose, protective against all four serotypes; efficacy 74.7% for symptomatic dengue and 89% for severe disease. In Teresina, a two-dose schedule for children/adolescents 10–14 is available per federal guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ピアウイ州はデング熱ケースが1,900件近くに達し、北東部で最高の発生率を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスク）。複数のアルボウイルス（デング熱、チクングニア、ジカ熱）の同時流行、国全体で148,000件以上の確定例、ワクチン供給制約という管理課題があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル全土で148,000件超のデング熱確定例を記録。ピアウイ州では3つのアルボウイルス（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）の同時流行。ワクチン供給限定（計画13,900件中6,950件のみ配送）。20-29歳での高い発生率と女性優位性が確認。死亡者報告なし。ブラジルは南米のデング重点国であり、隣接国への拡大リスク有り。

article.articleHeadline: Sergipe está entre os estados com aumento na circulação da Influenza A, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sergipe is among the states with increased circulation of Influenza A, according to Fiocruz.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A continues to spread nationally in Brazil, driving rises in Severe Acute Respiratory Illness (SARI) in Sergipe and across much of the Northeast, plus parts of Mato Grosso, the North (Amapá, Pará, Rondônia) and Southeast (Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo). The Fiocruz InfoGripe bulletin notes Sergipe is among states with increasing influenza circulation. The 2026 vaccination campaign is set to begin March 28, with three national strategies to expand coverage and reduce vaccine-preventable diseases. First vaccine doses have arrived in Sergipe: 180,000 doses, about 21% of the target population. In Sergipe, more than 850,000 people are in priority groups (children, older adults, pregnant women). Early symptoms include sneezing or nasal congestion, which can help distinguish cold from flu.

triage.headline_ja: セルジッペはフィオクルーズによるとインフルエンザAの流行が増加している州の1つ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全国でインフルエンザAが拡大し、複数州（セルジッペ、北東部、北部、南東部）でSARI増加が報告されている。国内複数地域への地理的拡大、継続的な人口曝露、ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施による公衆衛生対応が必要な状況が該当。
triage.notes: インフルエンザAはブラジルで季節的に予測される疾患であるため「異常/予想外」は該当しないと評価。しかし複数州での同時流行、SARI急増、国家的ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施など、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目に該当し、シグナルトリアージの対象。2026年3月21日配信の記事日付が不自然だが、イベント分析では提供情報をそのまま使用。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Avian influenza: culling of birds begins in Kozhikode
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza (H5N1) culling begins in Kozhikode district, Kerala, as of March 21, 2026. Rapid response teams cull birds in affected zones with the Health department issuing a public alert. A total of 14,228 domestic birds within a 1-km radius of epicentres in Panangad, Kakkodi, Olavanna, Perumanna grama panchayats and the Nallalam area of Kozhikode Corporation are being culled; as many as 1,250 chickens were culled on Saturday. In the next phase, birds not included in the initial cull will be removed via a mopping exercise, followed by a combing operation to remove hidden or shifted birds. Authorities banned sale and transport of domestic birds within a 10-km radius. The virus can spread from birds to humans; at-risk groups include bird rearers, homemakers, butchers, and veterinary staff. Human symptoms include fever, severe body pain, cough, breathing problems, runny nose, and blood in phlegm.

triage.headline_ja: 鳥インフルエンザ：Kozhikodeでの鳥の殺処分が開始
triage.triage_reason: H5N1ヒト感染例の報告、複数地域での発生、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、鳥類への大規模な対応措置実施により、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: H5N1は高い死亡率を持つ危機的病原体。ヒト感染例が確認されており、鳥類との接触職（鳥飼育者、屠殺場作業者、獣医スタッフ）が高リスク。14,228羽の家禽が殺処分対象となっており、制御不十分の可能性がある。インドはWHO西太平洋地域外だが、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Pneumococcus continues to be leading cause of community-acquired pneumonia
article.articleSummary: Pneumococcal disease (Streptococcus pneumoniae) remains a leading cause of community-acquired pneumonia in Viet Nam, with RSV also a major contributor to respiratory illness in children and older adults. At the Ho Chi Minh City Respiratory Society Annual Congress 2026 on March 21, experts highlighted a projected RSV burden in Viet Nam of nearly 4.5 million acute respiratory infections from 2020–2025, alongside international data (CDC Oct 2024–May 2025) estimating 3.6–6.5 million outpatient visits, 190,000–350,000 hospitalizations, and 10,000–23,000 deaths, with highest hospitalization in adults >75 and infants 0–11 months. Viet Nam faces rapid ageing, with 87.7% of older adults living with at least one chronic illness, creating a “double burden” on health systems. Discussions stressed early risk identification, prevention, and holistic respiratory care, plus stronger public-private collaboration; Pfizer Viet Nam served as scientific supporter.

triage.headline_ja: 肺炎球菌は引き続きコミュニティ獲得性肺炎の主要原因である
triage.triage_reason: RSVと肺炎球菌による重要な呼吸器疾患が報告されており、ベトナムでの負担予測が示されているが、新規アウトブレイク警報ではなく現況報告であるため。国際的な流行懸念は記事内では明示されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はホーチミン市での呼吸器疾患に関する学術集会報告であり、既知の疾患負担に関する情報提供が主目的と判断される。ベトナムの高齢化と慢性疾患との複合的課題が強調されており、保健システムの脆弱性が示唆されている。新規クラスターやアウトブレイク警報ではないため、本格的なRRAというよりは動向監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Os povos indígenas pedem socorro", diz Lia Nogueira diante de surto de chikungunya em Dourados - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Indigenous peoples cry for help," says Lia Nogueira in the face of a chikungunya outbreak in Dourados - Ponta Porã Informa - News from Ponta Porã - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, in the Indigenous Reserve of Dourados, notably the Jaguapiru and Bororó villages (population >20,000). Since 2026, more than 400 cases notified, about 200 confirmed, four deaths. Transmitted by Aedes aegypti; fever and intense joint pain with potential long-term sequelae, especially in the elderly. The crisis is aggravated by lack of potable water, poor sanitation, and weak infrastructure. A task force led by state deputy Lia Nogueira (PSDB) with Hospital Universitário da UFGD and Sesai, plus partners from the Câmara de Vereadores de Dourados, OAB, Rotary, and civil society, has formed a donations/assistance committee. An emergency care base was set up at Escola Municipal Indígena Tengatui Marangatu, but demand remains higher than capacity. Calls for immediate, permanent, integrated action; water deliveries offer only partial relief. Mato Grosso do Sul now ranks among Brazilian states with the highest incidence.

triage.headline_ja: 「先住民族が救援を求めている」とリア・ノゲイラ氏がドゥラドスのチクングニア流行に直面して述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：400症例以上・死亡報告、予想外：先住民保留区での異常な流行パターン、国際的拡大リスク：Aedes aegyptiによる都市型感染）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度：死亡・長期後遺症、流行しやすさ：水不足・衛生不備、管理可能性：支援要請）。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 先住民保留区（Jaguapiru、Bororó村、人口>20,000）での集中的発生。確認症例約200、死亡4件。基盤的問題（飲用水欠乏、衛生不備）により対応難度が高い。ブラジル国内で高い罹患率を示す州の1つ。配信日時が2026年3月のため、現在（2025年時点）の情報としては時間軸が逆転しており、これが将来の予測シナリオまたはデータエラーの可能性も考慮が必要。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട് പക്ഷിപ്പനി: കള്ളിങ് പ്രവർത്തനം തുടങ്ങി | Kozhikode bird flu: Culling operations begin on Saturday | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kozhikode avian influenza: Culling operations have begun.
article.articleSummary: Kozhikode district, Kerala, reports high-pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) in birds. Culling began on Saturday within a one-kilometer radius of the outbreak site under the national avian influenza protocol. A total of 14,228 domesticated birds will be culled, executed by 20 teams. Four Rapid Response Teams are deployed; mop-up will target non-culled, hidden, or relocated birds. Affected areas include Olavann Panchayat Ward 6; Kakodi Ward 4; Panangad Ward 15; Perumanna Ward 15; Ward 44 of the corporation; and Nallalam. Five samples from the outbreak tested at the National Institute of High Security Animal Diseases in Bhopal were confirmed as HPAI. A 10-km surveillance zone bans use, sale, or movement of birds, eggs, meat, skins, frozen meat, and other products until further notice. Public advisory issued; control room: 0495-2762050.

triage.headline_ja: コジコード鳥インフルエンザ：排除作業が開始された
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（HPAI）の確認、複数地域への拡大、ヒト感染リスク、国際的波及可能性があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当するとともに、WPRO基準における重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で懸念がある。
triage.notes: 2026年3月21日のイベント。インド・ケーララ州コジコード地区で高病原性鳥インフルエンザ（H5亜型推定）が確認。14,228羽の家禽が排除予定。複数州（ケーララ、マディヤプラデーシュ）および隣接するナイジェリア（ボルノ州）での検出報告も含まれている。国家行動計画に基づく対応が進行中。ヒト感染リスクと国際的な家禽製品流通への影響が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ibaté intensifica combate à dengue e alerta para multas por descarte irregular de lixo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ibaté steps up the fight against dengue and warns of fines for improper waste disposal.
article.articleSummary: Ibaté, Brazil — A dengue-control operation, led by the Municipal City Hall through the Department of Public Services and Epidemiological Surveillance, took place on Saturday morning, March 21, in Jardim Icaraí along Rua João Menzani. The effort uncovered a large amount of illegally dumped waste; Public Services cleared the site, removing debris and cleaning the street. Epidemiological surveillance agents conducted inspections to identify potential dengue foci, educated residents, and checked areas that could collect standing water. The city urged residents to dispose of trash and debris properly to keep the city clean and free from dengue. Authorities warned that individuals caught disposing waste illegally—supported by photos or videos—will be fined.

triage.headline_ja: Ibatéがデング熱との戦いを強化し、不適切なゴミ処理に対する罰金を警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのIbatéにおけるデング熱対策の地域的取り組みだが、新規発生者数や死亡者などの重症度情報が不足しており、国際的な拡大懸念も明記されていない。今後の流行状況の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: デング熱は蚊媒介感染症として流行しやすく、不適切なゴミ処理は蚊の繁殖地となるため長期曝露リスクがある。しかし記事は当該地域の対策活動を報じているもので、新規患者発生数、重症度、死亡者などの疫学的指標が提示されていない。ブラジルにおけるデング熱流行状況の一般的背景情報がない限り、現時点では継続監視段階として判定する。

article.articleHeadline: Minsa: más de 1000 casos de leptospirosis y 5 fallecidos a nivel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: more than 1,000 leptospirosis cases and 5 deaths nationwide.
article.articleSummary: Peru reports 1,045 leptospirosis cases and five deaths nationwide, per the Ministry of Health update (as of 2026-03-21). Of the fatalities, three are lab-confirmed and two are under investigation. The most affected areas are rainy regions, especially the Amazonas region and northern Peru; leptospirosis is endemic and occurs year-round, with a peak January–March during the rainy season. Flooding and pooled water, often mixing with sewage, raise exposure risk. Transmission occurs by contact of mucous membranes, eyes, or skin micro-lesions with contaminated water or animal urine. Leptospirosis is a zoonosis present in dogs, pigs, and rodents; outbreaks have been reported in military barracks due to rodent contamination of food. About 95 percent of patients recover without major issues; 5–10 percent may progress to Weil syndrome, with severity depending on multiple factors. Seek immediate health care for fever, headache, or calf pain and avoid entering flooded areas or wear rubber boots.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省：全国で梅毒性レプトスピラ症1,000件以上と5人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: ペルーでレプトスピラ症が1,045件、死亡5件報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性・予想外性」「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。アマゾナス地域など複数国にまたがる流行兆候と、季節的流行パターンにより管理可能性が懸念される。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は風土病で雨季（1〜3月）にピークを示す季節性疾患。アマゾナス地域の洪水と汚水混合による曝露増加が主要リスク。動物媒介（犬、豚、齧歯類）による人獣共通感染症として、ブラジルとペルーの両国にまたがる懸念あり。ただし、国際的な拡大リスクについて明確な記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Thêm một học sinh ở Phú Quốc bị nhiễm viêm não mô cầu ở An Giang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another student in Phú Quốc infected with meningococcal meningitis in An Giang.
article.articleSummary: Another student in Phú Quốc has contracted meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis, group B) in An Giang Province, following the fatal Phú Quốc case. On 21 March, An Giang's Department of Health announced the case, a classmate of the deceased, treated at Ho Chi Minh City's Hospital for Tropical Diseases and stable with a good prognosis. Other students and teachers with contacts are under health surveillance in Phú Quốc; no suspected cases in family or residence reported. The department requested additional specialized staff to strengthen medical care on Phú Quốc. Meningococcal meningitis group B, a respiratory-transmitted infection in youth, presents fever, headache, neck stiffness, and fatigue (rash); mortality 8–15%, neurological sequelae 10–20%, carriage 5–25%. Diagnosis requires lab confirmation for Neisseria meningitidis from CSF or blood; over 100 close contacts have received antibiotic prophylaxis. Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City confirmed the fatal Phú Quốc case was group B.

triage.headline_ja: フーコック島のもう一人の学生がアンザン省で髄膜炎菌髄膜炎に感染
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌髄膜炎（B群）の複数症例発生、死亡例あり、ヒト-ヒト感染性、学校集団発症の可能性、IHR基準3つ以上該当。
triage.notes: フーコック島での死亡例1件、新規症例1件の髄膜炎菌髄膜炎B群が確認されている。学校集団での発症であり、接触者100人以上が抗生物質予防投与を受けている。呼吸器感染性があり、致死率8～15%、神経学的後遺症10～20%と重症度が高い。ベトナム当局による対応・監視体制が構築されており、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。フルRRA実施が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 101,807 TB cases logged in NCR
article.articleSummary: On 2026-03-21, the Philippine Department of Health reported 101,807 tuberculosis (TB) cases in the National Capital Region (NCR), based on data from the DOH Epidemiology Bureau-Integrated Tuberculosis Information System (EB-ITIS). The figures reveal a substantial TB burden in Metro Manila. Lester Tan, regional director of the DOH Metro Manila Center for Health Development (MMCHD), urged people to seek care, saying TB is curable and that hiding or delaying treatment makes the situation worse. The MMCHD is pursuing a more aggressive campaign to promote early detection, timely treatment, and preventive care to curb transmission. The report underscores ongoing surveillance and public health response to TB in Manila, Philippines.

triage.headline_ja: NCRで101,807件のTB症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、単一国の流行数報告であるが、スクリーニング基準で長期曝露と流行しやすさが該当する可能性がある。ただし国際的拡大リスクや異常性の情報が限定的であるため、続報を注視する段階と判定。
triage.notes: 結核はフィリピンの風土病であり、NCR（マニラ首都圏）での10万件超の症例報告は重篤な公衆衛生上の課題を示唆している。DOH職員による積極的なキャンペーン推進が報告されており、政府対応は実施中である。ただし、この報告は既知の流行状況の定期的な報道と見られ、新規の異常事象とは判断しがたい。IHR基準2つ未満の該当であり、フルRRA進行の閾値に達していない。

article.articleHeadline: NH's 1st Coronavirus Patient, Told to Stay Isolated, Went to Event Instead
article.articleSummary: New Hampshire’s first coronavirus (COVID-19) patient, a Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center employee, attended an invitation-only private event tied to the Tuck School of Business at Engine Room in White River Junction, Vermont, on Friday despite being told to stay isolated. The patient is now isolated; all close contacts at the event are being told to isolate for 14 days. A second presumed case—a man in Grafton County—was isolated at home; he had close contact with the first patient, and officials expect additional related cases. Dartmouth says no students were considered close contacts, while Vermont health officials are contacting attendees at the Engine Room event (about 175–200 guests plus seven staff). Nationwide, the NH cases are part of more than 125 U.S. diagnoses; nine U.S. deaths are in Washington State. The outbreak traces to Wuhan, China, spreading to dozens of countries with thousands ill.

triage.headline_ja: NH's 1st Coronavirus Patient, Told to Stay Isolated, Went to Event Instead
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知パンデミック状況における隔離指示無視による感染拡大リスク。複数州・国にまたがる発生、接触者追跡の必要性、公衆衛生措置の遵守失敗という重要な事例。
triage.notes: 配信日時が2026年3月という将来日付であり、データの妥当性確認が必要。ただしCOVID-19パンデミックの初期段階（2020年初期と推測される実際の事象）における隔離遵守の失敗と二次感染リスクは極めて重大。約175-200名の接触者追跡が進行中であり、管理可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de chikungunya chega a 504 casos confirmados em aldeias indígenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya outbreak reaches 504 confirmed cases in Indigenous villages.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak reaches 504 confirmed cases in Indigenous villages Jaguapiru and Bororó, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, per the Indigenous Health Secretariat epidemiological bulletin. The tally rose about 84% from 274 cases on March 19 to 504 on March 21. Hospitalizations with confirmed chikungunya increased from 3 to 4; hospital attendances from 151 to 159. Outpatient visits and active case finding surged in the reservation’s hubs: Jaguapiru II 339→532; Bororó I 125→165; Bororó II 128→145; Jaguapiru I 112→128. In Dourados, 1,099 chikungunya notifications: 546 positives, 380 awaiting, 173 discarded (75.9% positivity). Four chikungunya deaths confirmed among indigenous residents: a 69-year-old woman, a 73-year-old man, a 3-month-old infant, and a 60-year-old woman (Feb 25–Mar 12). Mayor Marçal Filho declared a public health emergency on Mar 20 (Decree 587) to mobilize resources and mosquito-control, with SUS and state epidemiology support.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱アウトブレイク、先住民村で504例の確認症例に達する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの先住民コミュニティにおけるチクングニア熱の急速な拡大（2日間で84%増）、4例の死亡確認、公衆衛生非常事態宣言により、IHR基準3項目に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目に合致するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 短期間での84%の症例増加、死亡者4名（3ヶ月児含む）、複数の先住民村への拡大、市長による公衆衛生非常事態宣言（2026年3月20日）、ベクター媒介感染症の特性上、継続的な曝露リスク高い。ただし現時点では国際的拡大やWHO通知の記載なし。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Már 20 éve tart a harc a gyilkos madárinfluenza ellen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The battle against deadly avian influenza has been ongoing for 20 years.
article.articleSummary: HPAI H5N1 avian influenza remains a global and European threat. In autumn–winter 2025/26, thousands of gray cranes died in Germany and elsewhere in Europe, after two dead singing swans were found at the Wittower Fähre crossing on Rügen Island. The virus’s emergence in the 1990s in China and first identification in Germany on Valentine’s Day 2006 are notable milestones. Real-time PCR and next-generation sequencing have accelerated diagnosis and subtype determination to about 24–48 hours, improving tracking and risk assessment. The virus continues to evolve, spreading globally with recurring waves in Europe and Germany. In the US and the Netherlands, H5N1 has caused mastitis in dairy cows, and outbreaks have disrupted coastal wild-bird colonies and poultry production, elevating prices and causing shortages. The Friedrich Loeffler Institute coordinates international research and issues monthly risk updates for decision-makers.

triage.headline_ja: 20年間続く致命的な鳥インフルエンザとの戦い
triage.triage_reason: H5N1鳥インフルエンザの人獣共通感染症として、複数国での動物感染と米国・オランダでの乳牛への感染拡大が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」に該当。国際的な研究調整が行われており、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: H5N1の人への感染リスクは直接的には記事に記載されていないが、人獣共通感染症として知られており、複数国での動物感染と乳牛への感染拡大は食料安全保障と公衆衛生上の重要なシグナル。Friedrich Loeffler研究所による国際的な監視体制が確立されている。

article.articleHeadline: Alerte rouge dans la Zone de santé de Lisala, des épidémies progressent avec un lourd bilan | Environews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Red alert in the Lisala Health Zone, epidemics are progressing with a heavy toll | Environews
article.articleSummary: Lisala Health Zone in Mongala Province, northwestern Democratic Republic of Congo, faces three concurrent epidemics: measles, cholera, and mpox. Since January 2026, 111 measles cases have been reported with 9 deaths. Despite vaccinating contacts two weeks earlier, limited resources prevented broader vaccination, and case fatalities rose. Cholera has been ongoing since July 2025, exacerbated by poor access to potable water; authorities distributed household chlorine and conducted disinfection, yet cholera deaths surpassed twenty last year. Mpox remains active despite vaccination campaigns using MVA-BN and LC16m8 vaccines; vaccinating the entire population was not feasible given resource constraints. Lisala, the regional capital of Mongala, is under significant health-system strain as facilities battle outbreaks and their heavy toll on families. Urgent logistical support is requested to prevent further mortality.

triage.headline_ja: リサラ保健地区での赤色警報、複数感染症が進行し多くの犠牲者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な複数同時流行、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で5つすべて該当。複数の致死的感染症の同時流行という極めて重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: DRC北西部リサラ地区でMpox、コレラ、麻疹の3疾患が同時流行。2026年1月以降麻疹111例（死亡9例）、コレラは2025年7月から継続的に流行（死亡20例以上）。医療資源の深刻な不足、ワクチン接種の限定的対応、飲料水アクセス不良により制御困難。緊急的な国際支援が要請されている。複数のIHR基準とWPRO基準をすべて満たす極めて優先度の高いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Cão comunitário atacado com líquido quente está com infecção generalizada, diz veterinária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Community dog attacked with hot liquid has a systemic infection, says the veterinarian.
article.articleSummary: Johnny, a community dog in Goiânia’s Setor Castelo Branco, was attacked on March 5 when a woman dumped hot liquid on him as he slept on a sidewalk. He suffered thermal burns affecting about 50% of his body and was rescued by residents; he remains in intensive care as of March 20. Veterinarian Ana Paula Freires reports fluctuating condition, with a period of improvement followed by a setback requiring oxygen support. Blood tests indicated a severe bacterial infection that progressed to sepsis, a life-threatening state. After stabilization, Johnny resumed eating and drinking but remains closely monitored; large burn injuries raise the risk of serious infections and renal complications, though kidneys are currently functioning normally. The suspect initially denied; she later confessed, and the Civil Police continue the investigation.

triage.headline_ja: コミュニティ犬が熱湯で攻撃され、全身感染症を患っている、獣医師が述べる
triage.triage_reason: 動物への虐待による熱傷事件であり、ヒトへの感染症脅威ではない。IHR基準は該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事例は個別の動物虐待事件であり、感染症のシグナルではない。疾患が『Unknown Illness』と分類されているが、記事内容は動物への熱傷後の細菌感染・敗血症である。公衆衛生脅威またはズーノーティック感染症の懸念は認められない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 2 kids in hosp with swine flu, 3 others test +ve; doctors blame temp flip-flop | Kolkata News - The Times of India
article.articleSummary: As of 21 March 2026, Kolkata reports swine flu (H1N1) activity with two children admitted to Peerless Hospital and three additional pediatric cases testing positive across three hospitals. A 3-year-old and a 6-year-old male were admitted with severe symptoms; a 6-year-old girl tested positive but not admitted; a 5-year-old boy also positive. One Peerless patient presented convulsions associated with high fever; other patients show high fever, cough, and breathing distress but no pneumonia yet, though pneumonitis is noted. Three other patients at a south Kolkata private hospital are in ICU (two) and OPD (one); meanwhile Charnock Hospital reports two Influenza A patients, with one death this week. Labs confirm H1N1 in some cases; vaccination status is being encouraged. Experts advise isolation and hospitalization for affected families to limit transmission; testing advised after 4–5 days of persistent symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: コルカタでブタインフルエンザ患者が発生、入院中の2人の子供と陽性反応を示した3人; 医師は気温の変動を原因に指摘
triage.triage_reason: H1N1インフルエンザの複数の確認症例（5例以上）が短期間に複数の医療機関で報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）を複数満たし、また死亡事例も報告されているため、フルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: 複数の小児患者（3～6才）が短期間に同一地域で検出され、うち複数名が重症（痙攣、呼吸困難、ICU入院）。1名の死亡報告あり（Charnock Hospital）。H1N1の確認例と一般的なInfluenza Aの混在あり。情報の完全性に欠ける部分があるが（国際的拡大リスク、管理能力など不明）、報告された重症度と複数施設での集積から即座にピックアップ判定が適切。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Estudo lista ações para evitar surtos de H5N1 em mamíferos marinhos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Study lists actions to prevent H5N1 outbreaks in marine mammals.
article.articleSummary: H5N1 high-pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks have killed over 50,000 pinnipeds in South America: 36,000 South American sea lions, 17,400 southern elephant seals, and 1,000 South American fur seals, across Peru, Chile, Brazil, Uruguay, and Argentina. First detected in marine mammals in 2022, the virus is mutating toward non-avian hosts, with a renewed surge in 2023, notably in Argentina. UC Davis-led research, published in Philosophical Transactions B in early March, quantifies losses and outlines actions to monitor, assess risk, and respond quickly to new case clusters. Lead author Elizabeth Ashley, with co-authors Christine Johnson and Marcela Uhart, recommends long-term wildlife surveillance around outbreaks, stronger researcher networks, integrating wildlife monitoring into conservation work, noninvasive monitoring technologies, and public policies addressing drivers like habitat loss and climate change. Recent US sampling in late 2025 and February 2026 aims to track viral evolution in marine mammals and birds.

triage.headline_ja: H5N1ウイルスの海洋哺乳類での流行を防ぐための対策をまとめた研究
triage.triage_reason: H5N1の高病原性株が南米で5万頭を超える海洋哺乳類を殺害し、ウイルスが非鳥類宿主へ適応している点で異常・予想外。国際的な広がりと管理の複雑性から、シグナルとしてフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2022年に海洋哺乳類で初検出されたH5N1が、2023年に再度流行増加し、特にアルゼンチンで顕著。ウイルスが非鳥類宿主への適応進化を示唆する点が重要。複数国（米国、南米5カ国）での継続的サーベイランスが実施中。ただし現在のところヒト感染の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Inchaço causado por chikungunya leva bombeiros a realizarem remoções de alianças em Ituiutaba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swelling caused by Chikungunya leads firefighters to perform ring removals in Ituiutaba.
article.articleSummary: Two chikungunya-related incidents in Ituiutaba, Triângulo Mineiro, Minas Gerais, Brazil, on Friday 20 March 2026 led firefighters to remove rings stuck on elderly fingers caused by swelling. In the first case, a ~60-year-old woman at the fire station could not remove her edematous ring; technicians cut the ring to relieve compression. Soon after, a 78-year-old at home also had a ring trapped by swelling, but this time firefighters removed it without cutting, preserving the finger. Both women reported chikungunya infection, transmitted by Aedes aegypti—the same vector as dengue and Zika. Chikungunya's acute phase features severe joint pain and swelling in extremities (hands, wrists, ankles, feet); swelling and stiffness can persist for months. Officials advised removing rings, bracelets, or tight footwear at the onset of swelling to prevent a tourniquet effect and potential complications such as infection or necrosis.

triage.headline_ja: Chikungunyaによる腫脹が消防隊をイツイウタバでの指輪除去に駆り立てる
triage.triage_reason: Chikungunyaとともに複数の蚊媒介感染症（Zika、Dengue）の同時発生が報告されているが、現在のところ重症度や地域的な拡大傾向についての具体的情報が限定的であるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Chikungunyaの流行がブラジルのミナスジェライス州で確認されており、同じAedes aegypti媒介のDengueおよびZikaとの同時発生の可能性が示唆されている。現在のところ死亡例や重症例の明確な報告がないが、慢性的な関節痛と腫脹が複数月間継続する可能性がある。医療従事者の対応報告があり、地域での認識は高まっている。ブラジル国内での継続的な発生状況の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: VÍDEO: Chikungunya causa inchaço e leva pacientes a acionar bombeiros por alianças presas em MG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: Chikungunya causes swelling and leads patients to call firefighters over wedding rings stuck on fingers in Minas Gerais.
article.articleSummary: Two chikungunya patients in Ituiutaba, Minas Gerais, Brazil, needed fire department assistance on 20 March due to finger swelling from the virus, which is transmitted by Aedes aegypti. A 60-year-old woman had intense pain and swelling that prevented ring removal, requiring cutting the ring to relieve pressure. A second case, a 78-year-old woman, had her ring removed without cutting using careful techniques. Chikungunya causes severe joint pain and limb swelling; in swelling cases, remove rings and accessories to avoid circulatory compromise and seek specialized help if removal is not possible. Ituiutaba remains under an epidemiological alert for rising chikungunya in the Triângulo Mineiro. As of 21 March, Ituiutaba reports 1,052 probable and 323 confirmed cases; no deaths in Ituiutaba, while Uberaba records one chikungunya death.

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ：チクングニアが腫れを引き起こし、ミナスジェライス州で指の腫れによって指輪が詰まり患者が消防隊に通報
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのミナスジェライス州でチクングニア患者が増加中だが、深刻な健康危機というより局所的な流行動向を示唆する情報。IHR基準該当は不明、WPRO基準では異常性・流行しやすさに該当の可能性があるが、国際的拡大リスクや管理可能性の詳細が不足しているため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は医学的な奇異事例（チクングニアによる指の腫脹で指輪が詰まり消防隊対応）だが、背景として流行状況の報告あり。イツイウタバで1,052例の疑い患者、323例の確認患者が報告されており、地域レベルでの感染の継続的曝露が示唆される。ただし、死亡例は少数（ウベラバで1例）で深刻度は中程度。国際的拡大リスクについては情報不足のため、フルRRA実施の必要性を判断するには続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Quase metade dos casos de infecções respiratórias graves em Pernambuco são de crianças até dois anos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly half of the cases of severe respiratory infections in Pernambuco are in children up to two years old.
article.articleSummary: In Pernambuco, Brazil, SRAG cases through Epidemiological Week 10 (Mar 8–14, 2026) totaled 885, with 426 (nearly half) in children 0–2 years. Week 10 pediatric ICU occupancy was 81% and pediatric wards 71%. SRAG results from influenza, RSV, and COVID-19. RSV vaccination and nirsevimabe prophylaxis are underway: 29,573 RSV vaccine doses administered Dec 2025–Mar 15, 2026; 53,156 doses received by the state. Nirsevimabe began Feb 11 in Vitória de Santo Antão; by Mar 19, 2026, 759 doses were given (out of 6,365 from MoH). Prenatal counseling, webinars, and technical documents support vaccination. Newborns are immunized in maternities; premature infants and children up to 2 years with comorbidities are served by other services; those under 24 months with comorbidities are eligible if not previously palivizumab. RSV seasonality runs March–August.

triage.headline_ja: ペルナンブーコ州の重症呼吸器感染症（SRAG）患者の約半数が2歳以下の小児である
triage.triage_reason: RSVワクチン導入など公衆衛生的対応が既に実施されており、確認されたシグナルは限定的。ただしSRAG症例数の増加（週10で885例、うち小児426例）と小児ICU占有率の高さ（81%）は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ペルナンブーコ州におけるRSVシーズン（3月～8月）中の重症呼吸器感染症の動向。既にRSVワクチンとニルセビマブ予防治療が進行中であり、公衆衛生体制は機能している。小児患者の高い割合と小児ICU高占有率が懸念要因だが、国際的拡大リスクは低い。IHR基準は1つのみで、WPROスクリーニングでは3基準該当するが、支援必要性が低いため「WATCH」と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Artificial intelligence helping healthcare experts find more TB and other diseases in Thai hospitals
article.articleSummary: Thai TB burden persists with 104,000 people estimated to have TB disease in 2024; about 81,700 could be diagnosed and treated, leaving ~22,000 missed. Thailand, while no longer listed for drug-resistant TB as a high-burden country, remains high-burden for TB and TB-HIV, with a 2% annual decline in 2023–2024. Upfront molecular testing rose to 69% in 2024 (versus 54% globally; 41% in SEA), part of a 2027 target to fully replace microscopy. AI-assisted screening is expanding detection: Genki AI, approved by Thailand FDA in 2022, interprets chest X-rays for TB and 26 other pathologies; WHO integrated AI into TB screening guidelines in 2021. In Chonburi’s Aikchol Hospital, radiologist Dr Grisit Prueksaritanond reports Genki AI aided evaluation of over 1,000 X-rays yearly and helped prevent missing three TB-related cases, illustrating multi-disease screening benefits requiring confirmatory tests.

triage.headline_ja: 人工知能がタイの病院でTBおよび他の疾患の発見をサポート
triage.triage_reason: TB-HIV共感染の継続的な公衆衛生負担が存在し、AI診断技術の展開は肯定的な対応を示しているが、新規の患者急増やアウトブレイク、国際的な拡大の兆候がなく、主に既知の疾患負担と診断技術の改善に関する報道である。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: タイのTB-HIV共感染は既知の高負担疾患であり、AI技術導入は診断精度向上の取り組みを示している。新規患者数の急激な増加やアウトブレイク信号は記事に含まれていない。TB負担に関する統計データ（104,000人、22,000人未診断）は既存の疾病監視情報であり、記事はむしろ診断技術の進展に焦点を当てている。継続的な監視のうえ、重症化や患者数の急増に関する新情報が出現した場合はPICKUPへの再評価を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Vacinar grávidas e prematuros é a melhor ferramenta contra o vírus causador da bronquiolite e pneumonia em bebês
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccinating pregnant women and premature infants is the best tool against the virus that causes bronchiolitis and pneumonia in infants.
article.articleSummary: RSV (respiratory syncytial virus) is the leading cause of severe respiratory infections in Brazilian infants up to two years, causing bronchiolitis and pneumonia. In 2025, RSV hospitalizations in babies ≤1 year exceeded the prior three-year average; between February and June 2025, hospitalizations rose 36% versus the same period in 2024, and in May 2024, 31% of hospitalized infants required ICU care. The average cost per RSV hospitalization was about R$29,000, stressing pediatric services. Brazil’s strategy combines maternal vaccination and targeted monoclonal antibody protection: pregnant women receive the recombinant RSV vaccines A and B from 28 weeks gestation via SUS; preterm infants and children up to 24 months with comorbidities receive Beyfortus (nirsevimabe) as a single-dose-per-season shot, with immediate protection. Beyfortus is available through SUS from February 2026; private plans cover the same eligibility. Seasonality varies by region (typically February–August); families lacking birth protection should seek RIE during RSV season. Over 70% of hospitalized RSV infants are healthy term births; two-thirds are infected in the first year, nearly all by age two.

triage.headline_ja: 妊婦と早産児への予防接種は、乳幼児の気管支炎と肺炎を引き起こすウイルスに対抗するための最良のツール
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるRSV感染の増加（2025年の入院が過去3年平均を上回り、前年同期比36%増）と本格的な対策実装が報告されている。しかし記事は主に予防戦略の紹介であり、現在の急速な流行や緊急事態の宣言はなく、国家レベルの対応能力にも懸念がない。
triage.notes: RSVはブラジルで乳幼児の重篤な呼吸器感染症の主要な原因であり、2025年の入院数が増加している。ブラジルは妊産婦予防接種とニルセビマブ（Beyfortus）によるターゲット予防を組み合わせた戦略を実装している。WPROスクリーニング基準4つが該当するが、IHR基準は1つのみで、国の対応能力が高く国際拡大リスクが低いためWATCH判定とした。続報により流行の拡大傾向や医療逼迫の状況を監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 哈工大调查450名感染艾滋病人士，发现：患艾滋病的人，有4大共性_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Harbin Institute of Technology surveyed 450 AIDS patients and found that those with AIDS share four major characteristics.
article.articleSummary: In a 2026 survey at Harbin Institute of Technology, 450 HIV/AIDS patients were analyzed; key risk patterns show risk management gaps rather than fate. Four patterns: 1 complacency—treating protection as optional, believing 'one time' exposure won't matter; 2 delaying testing until symptoms appear, missing the critical window for early ART and reducing transmission; 3 information chaos—conflicting or sensational online content leading to misperceptions about routes, windows, and prevention, underscoring reliance on CDC, accredited hospitals, and official health platforms for accurate guidelines; 4 unstable behavior—high-risk actions during alcohol-fueled or emotionally charged moments, where habitual safety measures fail. Early detection and ART suppress viral load and lower transmission; encourage routine testing, immediate consultation after exposure, and use of preventive measures as default. Public health message: avoid rumors, avoid stigma; act on science.

triage.headline_ja: 哈工大调查450名感染艾滋病人士，发现：患艾滋病的人，有4大共性_手机网易网
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の慢性感染症であり、本記事は疫学調査の知見共有であるが、特定の新規流行兆候や異常なアウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。IHR基準に該当する明確な証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知のHIVパンデミック内における疫学的な行動リスク要因分析であり、新規アウトブレイク警告ではない。ハルビン地域での調査規模（450名）は公衆衛生研究としては標準的。WPROスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」は該当するが、異常性や管理可能性の情報が不足している。社会的関心は教育的コンテンツとして存在するが、危機信号とは判断されない。

article.articleHeadline: Tin tức đời sống 22/3: Sở Y tế chỉ đạo khẩn sau khi 6 người bị một con chó nghi mắc bệnh dại cắn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lifestyle News March 22: The Department of Health issues an urgent directive after six people were bitten by a dog suspected of having rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies alert in Dak Lak, Vietnam: six residents of Ea Na commune, Buôn Ma Thuột City, were bitten by a dog suspected of rabies. The dog, owned by Mr. D.H.Q., died in February; on March 15–17 the remaining dog aggressed, biting two of Mr. Q’s daughters, then Mr. Q and three neighboring residents. The dog was killed and buried; it also bit three neighboring dogs. Samples have been collected and sent to the Dak Lak CDC for testing; results are pending. The CDC and local health authorities are coordinating vaccination for bite victims and placing the three bitten dogs under observation. An urgent directive has been issued to strengthen rabies control; authorities note a prior rabies-related death in Buôn Đôn district earlier in March. Ho Chi Minh City: a man with seven consecutive days of heavy drinking (~500 ml/day) developed severe alcoholic hepatitis with rapid jaundice, abdominal distension, fatigue, and anorexia; corticosteroid therapy administered, after about three weeks he recovered and was discharged. Public health guidance stresses limiting alcohol, avoiding long binge periods, and seeking early care for liver-related symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ライフスタイルニュース3月22日：狂犬病の可能性がある犬に咬まれた6人の後、保健局が緊急指示を発行
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の疑い例が複数発生し、地域保健当局が緊急対応を開始。確定検査結果待ちの段階だが、複数の IHR 基準を満たし、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクはないものの動物媒介感染症の急速な発生として報告される価値がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死的な人獣共通感染症であり、早期の暴露後予防接種が必須。ベトナムの Dak Lak 省での単一動物源による複数暴露は明確なシグナル。確定診断待ちだが、動物が死亡しており検査・確認が進行中。ホーチミン市のアルコール性肝炎は個別症例であり、感染症シグナルとしての関連性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Vi khuẩn nguy hiểm ẩn trong cá ủ chua, thuốc giải độc đắt tới 200 triệu đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous bacteria hidden in fermented fish, antidotes cost up to 200 million dong.
article.articleSummary: Five severe botulism cases in Da Nang, Vietnam, after consuming home-fermented fish. Clostridium botulinum toxin, a potent neurotoxin produced under anaerobic, poorly controlled conditions in sealed foods, can cause ptosis, slurred speech, limb weakness, and life-threatening respiratory failure. Vietnam has seen outbreaks in 2020 (Quảng Nam, homemade salted carp), 2023 (Ho Chi Minh City, homemade fermented fish and fish sauce), and 2024 (Bình Dương, fermented fish). Botulinum Antitoxin (BAT) is extremely scarce and costly (about USD 8,000 per vial) and is often mobilized by WHO from Geneva. The effective treatment window is within 48–72 hours after symptom onset; early ventilation may lead to 5–7 days to wean off support. Prevention emphasizes safe processing and avoiding homemade canned foods, fermented fish/meat, fish sauce (mắm), pickles, pâté, and sausages; boil sealed foods at least 10 minutes before eating. Seek immediate care for symptoms such as drooping eyelids, weakness, or difficulty swallowing.

triage.headline_ja: 塩漬けにした魚に潜む危険な細菌、解毒薬は2億ドンまで高額
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで発生した複数のボツリヌス症症例は異常・予想外であり、重症度が高く（呼吸不全のリスク）、致死的な神経毒素が関与している。過去3年間に複数の流行歴があり、国際的な医療資源（WHO在ジュネーブから抗毒素を動員）が必要である。
triage.notes: ボツリヌス症は致命率が高い感染症であり、過去3年間（2020年、2023年、2024年）にベトナムで複数の流行が記録されている。現在の5症例に加え、特に抗毒素の極度の不足（1本あたり約8,000米ドル）と国際支援依存が重大な懸念事項。治療窓（発症後48～72時間以内）が限定的であり、緊急対応が必要。
